title: Reproducible capillary fluctuation analysis of solid-liquid interfaces for stiffness and anisotropy calculations
abstract: The capillary fluctuation method (CFM) is widely used to compute solid--liquid interfacial properties from atomistic simulations, but its accuracy depends on choices in interface construction, wave-vector selection, sampling, and simulation geometry. Here, we develop a diagnostics-driven workflow for reproducible CFM calculations using pure Al as a representative system. Employing both ribbon models and thick two-dimensional references, we show that apparent linearity of the fluctuation spectrum alone does not ensure reliable stiffness or anisotropy estimates. Instead, a reliable CFM analysis requires a fitting window consistent with both temporal sampling and continuum capillary-wave assumptions, systematic sensitivity tests of the interface identification procedure, explicit propagation of replica variability, and independent verification of model-thickness convergence. We further propose a practical thickness-selection rule based on coexistence-temperature consistency, which enables finite-size effects to be controlled while retaining the substantial computational efficiency of ribbon geometries. By making the main sources of uncertainty explicit and diagnosable, the proposed workflow improves the reliability of the CFM as a quantitative tool and provides a foundation for its broader application to complex solid--liquid interfaces.
summary:
毛细管涨落法 (CFM) 广泛用于通过原子模拟计算固液界面特性，但其准确性取决于界面构造、波矢量选择、采样和模拟几何形状的选择。在这里，我们使用纯 Al 作为代表性系统，开发了一个诊断驱动的工作流程，用于可重复的 CFM 计算。采用带状模型和厚二维参考，我们表明仅波动谱的表观线性并不能确保可靠的刚度或各向异性估计。相反，可靠的 CFM 分析需要与时间采样和连续毛细波假设一致的拟合窗口、界面识别过程的系统灵敏度测试、复制变异性的显式传播以及模型厚度收敛的独立验证。我们进一步提出了一种基于共存温度一致性的实用厚度选择规则，该规则能够控制有限尺寸效应，同时保留带状几何形状的大量计算效率。

通过使不确定性的主要来源变得明确和可诊断，所提出的工作流程提高了 CFM 作为定量工具的可靠性，并为其更广泛地应用于复杂的固液界面奠定了基础。

title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
abstract: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has $\pm \pi/2$-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has $0$-flux ($\pi$-flux) within the parameter space of interest. We map out the topological phase diagram for each model, which reveals parameter regimes hosting $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and Ising topological orders, and we derive an analytical expression for the mass term of the Majorana fermions, the vanishing of which indicates a transition between these phases. We further establish the correspondence between individual vortices (i.e., flux excitations) and two species of anyons in the dimer limit, overcoming the obstacle faced by degenerate perturbation theory in treating odd-length elementary plaquettes. Interestingly, we find that two dimer limits of the maple-leaf model with distinct assignments of anyon species can be smoothly connected to each other in the vortex-free sector, but they are separated by fermion-gap-closing transitions in certain two-vortex sectors.
summary:
我们在五配位枫叶和网格晶格上构建了具有键依赖性各向异性相互作用的自旋模型，产生了类似于 Kitaev 蜂窝模型的精确 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 量子自旋液体。我们通过通量扇区、陈数和拓扑激发来表征所产生的基态。使用副本交换量子蒙特卡罗模拟，我们发现规范通量在足够低的温度下排序，使得每个单位三角形都有 $\pm \pi/2$-flux，其中符号在整个系统中是均匀的，并且每个单位六边形（正方形）在感兴趣的参数空间内都有 $0$-flux ($\pi$-flux)。我们绘制了每个模型的拓扑相图，它揭示了承载 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 和 Ising 拓扑序的参数状态，并且我们推导了马约拉纳费米子质量项的解析表达式，其消失表明了这些相之间的转变。我们进一步建立了个体涡旋（即通量激发）与二聚体极限中两种任意子之间的对应关系，克服了简并微扰理论在处理奇数长度基本斑块时面临的障碍。

有趣的是，我们发现枫叶模型的两个二聚体极限具有不同的任意子物种分配，可以在无涡扇区中平滑地彼此连接，但它们在某些双涡扇区中被费米子能隙闭合跃迁分开。

title: Quantum oscillations of helical edge states of periodically deformed 2D topological insulator in magnetic field
abstract: We study edge-state transport in a two-dimensional topological insulator with a periodically deformed edge subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Zeeman coupling breaks time-reversal symmetry and enables elastic backscattering, producing oscillations of the forbidden-band widths. In the strong-field regime, the gaps can close completely at discrete field values. In the weak-field regime, we identify an important class of periodic deformations for which the dominant semiclassical scattering is controlled by complex infinity rather than by the nearest turning points. We develop a semiclassical treatment of this process and establish its agreement with perturbation theory and direct numerical calculations. The gap modulation should produce observable oscillations of the edge conductance. Unlike conventional magnetic quantum oscillations, which are periodic in inverse field, the predicted oscillations are periodic in the magnetic field itself, with a period determined by the Fermi velocity and effective g-factor
summary: 我们研究二维拓扑绝缘体中的边缘态输运，该绝缘体的边缘在均匀磁场下周期性变形。塞曼耦合打破了时间反转对称性并实现弹性反向散射，产生禁带宽度的振荡。在强场状态下，间隙可以在离散场值处完全闭合。在弱场状态下，我们确定了一类重要的周期性变形，其主要半经典散射是由复无穷大而不是最近的转折点控制的。我们开发了该过程的半经典处理方法，并建立了其与微扰理论和直接数值计算的一致性。间隙调制应产生可观察到的边缘电导振荡。与逆场中周期性的传统磁量子振荡不同，预测的振荡在磁场本身中是周期性的，其周期由费米速度和有效 g 因子决定

title: Fukui-Kawakami chains: spectrum and hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry
abstract: Fukui and Kawakami showed that the trigonometric Haldane--Shastry (HS) spin chain can be deformed by introducing twisted boundary conditions. In this work we revisit the resulting twisted HS chains, which we call Fukui--Kawakami (FK) chains. We analyse their spectra in dependence of the twist parameter, utilising a direct connection with the (untwisted) HS chain. This allows us to explain why part of the spectrum can be described by Fukui and Kawakami's twisted Bethe equations, and can be constructed from Yangian highest weight states. These states can be labelled by combinatorial data called `motifs', as in the HS chain, which cover some of the (deformed) descendants. We furthermore show that there are other descendants which do not follow from these Bethe equations, but whose energy can be described as a sum of two single-particle energies, suggesting additional hidden symmetries. We then focus on the special case of antiperiodic boundary conditions, and show that this chain coincides with the `minimally polarised' long-range model recently introduced by Basu-Mallick, Finkel, and González-López. Remarkably, this connection implies that the antiperiodic chain has a hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry, which we use to relate the HS motifs to their `supersymmetric' $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ counterparts.
summary:
Fukui 和 Kawakami 证明三角 Haldane-Shastry (HS) 自旋链可以通过引入扭曲边界条件来变形。在这项工作中，我们重新审视由此产生的扭曲 HS 链，我们将其称为福井-川上 (FK) 链。我们利用与（未扭曲的）HS 链的直接连接，根据扭曲参数分析它们的光谱。这使我们能够解释为什么部分谱可以用 Fukui 和 Kawakami 的扭曲 Bethe 方程来描述，并且可以从 Yangian 最高权重态构建。这些状态可以用称为“基序”的组合数据来标记，就像在 HS 链中一样，它覆盖了一些（变形的）后代。我们还表明，还有其他后代并不遵循这些贝特方程，但其能量可以描述为两个单粒子能量的总和，这表明了额外的隐藏对称性。然后，我们关注反周期边界条件的特殊情况，并表明该链与 Basu-Mallick、Finkel 和 González-López 最近引入的“最小极化”长程模型一致。

值得注意的是，这种联系意味着反周期链具有隐藏的 $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 对称性，我们用它来将 HS 图案与其“超对称”$\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ 对应物联系起来。

title: Speed-quality tradeoff in a physical model of molecular sorting
abstract: Eukaryotic cells rely on membrane-mediated processes to compartmentalize biomolecules, counteracting diffusion-driven homogenization. These processes involve the selective sorting and packing of molecules into lipid vesicles, which are then dispatched to appropriate intracellular destinations. Previous works introduced an abstract statistical physics framework for studying this molecular distillation process, where the membrane was treated as static and the focus was on molecular aggregation and extraction. Here, we extend this framework to explicitly incorporate dynamic membrane behavior, including bending, curvature generation, and changes in membrane size due to vesicle fusion and fission events. Sorting domains drive membrane curvature, leading to vesicle formation, detachment, and a molecular distillation process that alters membrane size. Using mesoscopic modeling and numerical tools, we investigate the resulting interplay between membrane mechanics and molecular sorting. We determine a well-defined parameter region where vesicle fission and efficient molecular sorting occur, controlled by membrane rigidity, spontaneous curvature, and pressure difference across the membrane. We further identify a trade-off between speed and quality of molecular distillation: parameters that accelerate vesicle formation tend to reduce the quality of distillation, and vice versa. We propose maximization of the rate of negative entropy production as a natural criterion to optimally balance these competing effects. In this context, optimal parameters emerge naturally from the coupled dynamics of molecular aggregation and membrane mechanics, suggesting a possible strategy for cellular sorting systems to strike an efficient balance between rapid vesicle formation and high sorting quality.
summary:
真核细胞依靠膜介导的过程来划分生物分子，抵消扩散驱动的均质化。这些过程涉及选择性分选分子并将其包装到脂质囊泡中，然后将其分派到适当的细胞内目的地。之前的工作引入了一个抽象的统计物理框架来研究这种分子蒸馏过程，其中膜被视为静态，重点是分子聚集和萃取。在这里，我们扩展了这个框架，以明确地纳入动态膜行为，包括弯曲、曲率生成以及由于囊泡融合和裂变事件导致的膜尺寸变化。分选域驱动膜曲率，导致囊泡形成、分离以及改变膜尺寸的分子蒸馏过程。使用介观建模和数值工具，我们研究了膜力学和分子分选之间的相互作用。我们确定了一个明确的参数区域，在该区域中囊泡裂变和有效的分子分选发生，由膜刚性、自发曲率和跨膜压差控制。

我们进一步确定了分子蒸馏的速度和质量之间的权衡：加速囊泡形成的参数往往会降低蒸馏的质量，反之亦然。我们建议将负熵产生率最大化作为自然标准，以最佳地平衡这些竞争效应。在这种情况下，最佳参数自然地从分子聚集和膜力学的耦合动力学中产生，这表明细胞分选系统在快速囊泡形成和高分选质量之间取得有效平衡的可能策略。

title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than \(10^6\) atoms.
summary: 现代原子模拟越来越多地采用局域轨道来表示量子算子，产生稀疏块矩阵，其块形状随化学物种和基础选择而变化。传统的标量稀疏格式单独存储每个块的条目，模糊了这种局部结构并限制了高效块算法的使用。我们提出了 VBCSR，一个分布式稀疏矩阵库，它保留可变大小的原子块并加速大规模原子模拟的核心线性代数。统一接口自动将标量、统一基和多种类运算符映射到压缩稀疏行 (CSR)、块稀疏行 (BSR) 或可变块压缩稀疏行 (VBCSR)。我们先进的加速方法将相同形状的块分组，并将它们分配给优化的密集内核。在报告的基准测试中，VBCSR 在多个块稀疏基准测试中的性能优于经过测试的 Python 可访问参考实现。我们进一步在包含超过 \(10^6\) 个原子的 InP 纳米粒子应用中证明了 VBCSR。

title: Composition-dependent nonlinear viscoelastic-viscoplastic behavior and constitutive framework for digitally mixed polymers spanning the glass transition
abstract: Multi-material PolyJet printing produces voxel-scale digital mixtures of an elastomeric photopolymer (Agilus) and a glassy photopolymer (Vero), giving a material family whose room-temperature response ranges from elastomeric to glassy; a unified description spanning the family has remained challenging. Large-deformation uniaxial compression over nearly three orders of magnitude in strain rate reveals a nonlinear, rate-dependent load-unload response that evolves continuously with composition, from recoverable elastomeric hysteresis to glassy yield with post-yield softening, hardening, and substantial residual strain. Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) shows that each mixture has a single glass transition temperature ($T_g$) that shifts to higher temperature with both Vero fraction and frequency, so composition acts much as temperature or loading rate does. This time-composition equivalence motivates one constitutive structure for the whole family rather than a separate property set per mixture: an equilibrium hyperelastic network with three non-equilibrium, rate-dependent branches carrying reptational, intermolecular, and glassy resistance. Its properties are anchored at the two endpoints and interpolated by smooth composition scaling laws. The model captures the compression response of all seven calibrated compositions and predicts a withheld mixture from the scaling laws alone. Resolving the predicted stress into its branches shows the load passing from the elastomeric to the glassy mechanism, and the work from elastic storage to dissipation, as Vero content and rate rise. The glass transition that DMA maps at small strain therefore governs the large-strain deformation mechanisms. The framework gives a compact, physically based description of digitally mixed polymers and a predictive basis for designing functionally graded, architected multi-material structures.
summary:
多材料 PolyJet 打印可产生弹性光聚合物 (Agilus) 和玻璃状光聚合物 (Vero) 的体素级数字混合物，提供室温响应范围从弹性到玻璃的材料系列；跨家庭的统一描述仍然具有挑战性。应变率近三个数量级的大变形单轴压缩揭示了非线性、速率相关的加载-卸载响应，该响应随着成分的变化而不断演变，从可恢复的弹性体滞后到具有屈服后软化、硬化和大量残余应变的玻璃态屈服。动态机械分析 (DMA) 显示，每种混合物都有一个单一的玻璃化转变温度 ($T_g$)，该温度随着 Vero 分数和频率的变化而转变为更高的温度，因此成分的作用与温度或加载速率的作用非常相似。这种时间组成等价性激发了整个家族的一个本构结构，而不是为每个混合物设置一个单独的属性：一个平衡超弹性网络，具有三个非平衡、速率依赖的分支，具有爬行、分子间和玻璃态阻力。

其属性锚定在两个端点，并通过平滑的合成缩放法则进行插值。该模型捕获所有七种校准成分的压缩响应，并仅根据比例定律预测保留的混合物。将预测应力分解为其分支显示了随着 Vero 含量和速率的上升，负载从弹性体传递到玻璃态机构，以及从弹性存储到耗散的功。因此，DMA 在小应变下映射的玻璃化转变控制着大应变变形机制。该框架为数字混合聚合物提供了紧凑的、基于物理的描述，并为设计功能分级、结构化的多材料结构提供了预测基础。

title: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
abstract: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.
summary: 这项工作描述了晶体结构自旋轨道溢出的计算。自旋轨道溢出提供了材料具有拓扑特征的可能性的度量。溢出量还为 Choudhary 等人的机器学习分类器提供了参考量，该分类器预测溢出量是否超过指定阈值，而不是直接计算其数值。将完整的计算工作流程应用于绝缘化合物 BaMg2Bi2，得出的泄漏量为 2.094，而已发布的 VASP 泄漏量为 2.075，相当于 0.9% 的差异。该计算通过两个 Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) 溢出计算（有和没有自旋轨道耦合）、相对论赝势的作用以及随后的波函数重叠分析来描述。还研究了半金属的相同计算程序的局限性。

title: From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
abstract: Dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT) provides an efficient continuum framework for studying structure formation in inhomogeneous polymer systems, but its predictive accuracy depends on the choice of the nonlocal mobilities. Here, we construct mobility functions for moderately and strongly entangled homopolymer and diblock copolymer systems from the relaxation dynamics of single-chain structure factors, based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the Kremer-Grest model and analytical reptation theory. Single- chain mobilities are combined such that the resulting DSCFT accounts for the dependence of fluxes on local chain densities. The theory is then applied to the spinodal decomposition of symmetric homopolymer blends and diblock copolymer melts following a quench into the (micro)phase-separation regime. Predictions of DSCFT are systematically compared with MD simulations. Mobility functions derived from single-chain dynamics are found to reproduce the kinetics of structure formation more accurately than conventional Debye-type mobilities. We additionally investigate the influence of adding stochastic currents (noise) that are correlated according to the fluctuation-dissipation relation. At low noise levels, they enable the generation of equilibrium initial states and facilitate defect annealing. At high noise levels, however, nonolinear effects lead to discrepancies between DSCFT and MD simulations.
summary:
动态自洽场论（DSCFT）为研究非均匀聚合物体系中的结构形成提供了有效的连续框架，但其预测准确性取决于非局域迁移率的选择。在这里，我们基于 Kremer-Grest 模型的分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和解析爬行理论，从单链结构因素的松弛动力学构建了中度和强缠结均聚物和二嵌段共聚物体系的迁移率函数。组合单链迁移率，使得所得的 DSCFT 解释了通量对局部链密度的依赖性。然后将该理论应用于对称均聚物共混物和二嵌段共聚物熔体在骤冷至（微）相分离状态后的旋节线分解。 DSCFT 的预测与 MD 模拟进行了系统比较。发现源自单链动力学的迁移率函数比传统的德拜型迁移率更准确地再现结构形成的动力学。

我们还研究了添加根据波动耗散关系相关的随机电流（噪声）的影响。在低噪声水平下，它们能够生成平衡初始状态并促进缺陷退火。然而，在高噪声水平下，非线性效应会导致 DSCFT 和 MD 模拟之间存在差异。

title: Structural tuning of reduced exciton mass in layered HOIP compounds: Causation vs. correlation
abstract: Reduced exciton mass ($\mu$) was recently reported to correlate strongly with a framework distortion in a series of nine single-layer (2D) metal-halide perovskite (HOIP) compounds. Specifically, $\mu$ was observed to increase in tandem with an alternating PbI4 octahedral tilt about an in-plane axis. In this work, we use group representation theory to decompose the observed framework distortions into displacive symmetry modes of a common high-symmetry parent framework. We find that all nine distorted frameworks involve linear combinations of the same six symmetry modes, which have been reported to contribute to the framework distortions of a wide range of HOIP compounds. We show that these modes have highly correlated impacts on the band structure. To differentiate causation from correlation, we vary the amplitude of each mode independently and use density-functional theory to determine the resulting electronic band structures, from which $\mu$ is extracted. We find that bond-transverse displacements of the equatorial halide atoms increase $\mu$, while bond-transverse displacements of the apical halide atoms decrease it. Bond-axis displacements appear to have little or no effect on $\mu$. Our results demonstrate three new structure-property relationships, revealing a promising new avenue for exciton engineering in layered perovskite materials.
summary:
最近报道称，激子质量的减少（$\mu$）与一系列九种单层（2D）金属卤化物钙钛矿（HOIP）化合物的骨架畸变密切相关。具体而言，观察到 $\mu$ 随 PbI4 八面体绕面内轴的交替倾斜而串联增加。在这项工作中，我们使用群表示理论将观察到的框架扭曲分解为常见的高对称父框架的位移对称模式。我们发现所有九种扭曲骨架都涉及相同六种对称模式的线性组合，据报道这会导致多种 HOIP 化合物的骨架扭曲。我们表明这些模式对能带结构具有高度相关的影响。为了区分因果关系和相关性，我们独立地改变每种模式的幅度，并使用密度泛函理论来确定所得的电子能带结构，从中提取$\mu$。我们发现赤道卤化物原子的键横向位移增加了 $\mu$，而顶端卤化物原子的键横向位移则减少了 $\mu$。

键轴位移似乎对 $\mu$ 影响很小或没有影响。我们的结果证明了三种新的结构-性能关系，揭示了层状钙钛矿材料中激子工程的有前途的新途径。

title: Light alkali metal functionalized two-dimensional C5N monolayers for enhanced hydrogen storage
abstract: This work presents a density functional theory (DFT) investigation of a two-dimensional (2D) C5N monolayer functionalized with Li, Na, and K for hydrogen storage. Pristine C5N exhibits weak H2 adsorption, while alkali-metal functionalization significantly enhances its storage capability. The C5N monolayer can stably accommodate up to six metal dopants, with binding energies stronger than the corresponding cohesive energies, indicating resistance to metal aggregation. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further confirm the thermal stability of the functionalized systems at 300 K. Charge transfer from the metal dopants to C5N enhances polarization and strengthens H2 adsorption. Each dopant can adsorb up to eight H2 molecules, yielding a maximum of 48 H2 molecules per unit cell and gravimetric storage capacities of 9.42, 8.61, and 7.93 wt% for Li-, Na-, and K-functionalized C5N, respectively. The average H2 adsorption energies of -0.16 to -0.17 eV/H2 indicate moderate interactions suitable for reversible storage. Thermodynamic analysis further demonstrates favourable H2 adsorption/desorption under practical operating conditions, while desorption-temperature, recovery-time, and volumetric analyses support the potential reversibility and storage performance of these systems. Overall, alkali-metal-functionalized C5N emerges as a promising 2D material for efficient and reversible H2 storage.
summary:
这项工作提出了用 Li、Na 和 K 功能化用于储氢的二维 (2D) C5N 单层的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 研究。原始的C5N表现出较弱的H2吸附，而碱金属功能化显着增强了其存储能力。 C5N单层可以稳定容纳多达六种金属掺杂剂，其结合能比相应的内聚能更强，表明对金属聚集的抵抗力。从头算分子动力学模拟进一步证实了功能化系统在 300 K 下的热稳定性。从金属掺杂剂到 C5N 的电荷转移增强了极化并增强了 H2 吸附。每种掺杂剂最多可吸附 8 个 H2 分子，每个晶胞最多可吸附 48 个 H2 分子，Li、Na 和 K 功能化 C5N 的重量存储容量分别为 9.42、8.61 和 7.93 wt%。 -0.16 至 -0.17 eV/H2 的平均 H2 吸附能表明适合可逆存储的中等相互作用。

热力学分析进一步证明了在实际操作条件下有利的氢气吸附/解吸，而解吸温度、恢复时间和体积分析支持这些系统的潜在可逆性和存储性能。总体而言，碱金属功能化的 C5N 作为一种有前景的二维材料，可用于高效、可逆的氢气存储。

title: Hydrogen Storage on Transition-Metal-Decorated Nitrogen-Modified Carbon Nanoribbons
abstract: Recently synthesized carbon nanoribbons (CNRs) were investigated for hydrogen (H2) storage using first-principles density functional theory calculations. Pristine CNRs exhibited weak H2 adsorption; therefore, the host structure was modified by substituting carbon atoms at the C-H edges with 12 nitrogen atoms, followed by Mn and Y doping to enhance H2 binding. A maximum of five metal atoms could be accommodated on the 12N-CNRs. Electronic structure analysis revealed strong orbital hybridization between the metal atoms and the CNRs, while binding energy calculations confirmed the structural stability of the doped systems. Bader charge analysis further quantified the charge transfer between the metal atoms and the host structure. The average H2 adsorption energies were calculated to be -0.40 eV/H2 for the Mn-doped system and -0.25 eV/H2 for the Y-doped system, which are within the desirable range for reversible hydrogen storage. The maximum theoretical gravimetric storage capacities at 0 K reached 7.48 wt% for the Mn-doped system and 6.55 wt% for the Y-doped system. Under practical conditions of 30 atm and 298.15 K, the storage capacity of the Y-doped system decreased to 6.04 wt%, whereas the Mn-doped system maintained its full capacity of 7.48 wt%. Thermodynamic analysis indicated that H2 adsorption is favored at low temperatures and high pressures, while desorption becomes feasible at elevated temperatures and lower pressures. These results demonstrate that Mn- and Y-doped CNRs satisfy key U.S. Department of Energy requirements for reversible H2 storage and show promise as potential hydrogen storage materials under near-ambient conditions.
summary:
使用第一原理密度泛函理论计算研究了最近合成的碳纳米带（CNR）的氢（H2）存储。原始 CNR 表现出弱的 H2 吸附；因此，通过用 12 个氮原子取代 C-H 边缘的碳原子，然后通过 Mn 和 Y 掺杂来增强 H2 结合，对主体结构进行了修改。 12N-CNR 上最多可容纳 5 个金属原子。电子结构分析揭示了金属原子和 CNR 之间强烈的轨道杂化，而结合能计算证实了掺杂系统的结构稳定性。巴德电荷分析进一步量化了金属原子和主体结构之间的电荷转移。 Mn掺杂系统的平均H2吸附能为-0.40 eV/H2，Y掺杂系统的平均H2吸附能为-0.25 eV/H2，这在可逆储氢的理想范围内。 Mn掺杂体系在0 K时的最大理论重量存储容量达到7.48 wt%，Y掺杂体系达到6.55 wt%。

在30 atm和298.15 K的实际条件下，Y掺杂系统的存储容量下降至6.04 wt%，而Mn掺杂系统保持其全部容量7.48 wt%。热力学分析表明，在低温和高压下有利于氢气的吸附，而在高温和低压下则可以进行解吸。这些结果表明，Mn 和 Y 掺杂的 CNR 满足美国能源部对可逆储氢的关键要求，并显示出在近环境条件下作为潜在储氢材料的前景。

title: Enhanced Multifractality Induced by Non-Hermitian Disorder in Quantum Percolation
abstract: We investigate the interplay between geometric dilution and non-Hermitian disorder in the two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model. Non-Hermiticity is introduced through random imaginary on-site potentials, representing spatially uncorrelated gain and loss, while the hopping amplitudes remain reciprocal. By combining complex level-spacing statistics, participation entropy, and multifractal analysis, we characterize the localization properties of the eigenstates as functions of the disorder and the non-Hermiticity strength. Our finite-size scaling results show that non-Hermitian disorder shifts the quantum percolation threshold ($p_q$) toward larger occupation probabilities. Consequently, the fully delocalized phase is progressively suppressed and disappears at sufficiently strong disorder. This suppression is not a simple consequence of adding on-site disorder of a given strength, but is specifically enhanced by its imaginary character, as an equally strong real (Hermitian) on-site potential produces a weaker shift of $p_q$. Nevertheless, the intermediate region between the classical ($p_c$) and quantum percolation thresholds presents a genuine multifractal critical phase, while the localization-length exponent $\nu$ remains the same, relative to its Hermitian value. Altogether, our results demonstrate that random gain and loss enhance the multifractal regime while preserving the universality class of the quantum percolation transition.
summary:
我们研究了二维量子位点渗流模型中几何稀释和非厄米无序之间的相互作用。非厄米性是通过随机虚构的现场电势引入的，代表空间上不相关的增益和损耗，而跳变幅度保持倒数。通过结合复杂的能级间距统计、参与熵和多重分形分析，我们将本征态的局部化特性描述为无序和非厄米性强度的函数。我们的有限尺寸缩放结果表明，非厄米无序将量子渗流阈值 ($p_q$) 转向更大的占据概率。因此，完全离域相逐渐受到抑制，并在足够强的无序度下消失。这种抑制并不是添加给定强度的现场无序的简单结果，而是通过其虚数特征特别增强，因为同样强的真实（厄米特）现场势会产生较弱的 $p_q$ 偏移。

然而，经典 ($p_c$) 和量子渗流阈值之间的中间区域呈现出真正的多重分形临界相，而局域长度指数 $\nu$ 相对于其埃尔米特值保持不变。总而言之，我们的结果表明，随机增益和损失增强了多重分形状态，同时保留了量子渗流跃迁的普遍性类别。

title: Breakdown of the Overdamped Approximation in Fluctuating Environments
abstract: The overdamped approximation is widely used to describe Brownian motion in complex environments, but its validity becomes nontrivial when the friction coefficient itself fluctuates in time. We investigate this problem by comparing underdamped and overdamped Langevin dynamics subject to the same fluctuating friction and satisfying the fluctuation--dissipation relation at a common temperature. We show that environmental averaging and inertial elimination generally lead to different long-time transport when environmental fluctuations are fast compared with velocity relaxation. For rapidly fluctuating friction, the underdamped dynamics is governed by the arithmetic mean friction and yields $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langle\gamma\rangle$, whereas the overdamped dynamics gives $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langle\gamma^{-1}\rangle$. For a two-state Markov friction, we derive the finite-time effective diffusion coefficient exactly and identify the full crossover between these two regimes, controlled by the competition between velocity relaxation and environmental switching. We further establish the fast-fluctuation result for general stationary friction processes and verify it for a continuous log-Ornstein--Uhlenbeck environment, for which the characteristic crossover time can also be determined independently. Our results reveal a noncommutativity between environmental averaging and inertial elimination, establish a timescale-dependent criterion for the validity of overdamped dynamics in temporally heterogeneous environments, and show that rapid environmental fluctuations can enhance, rather than suppress, the consequences of inertia.
summary:
过阻尼近似被广泛用于描述复杂环境中的布朗运动，但当摩擦系数本身随时间波动时，其有效性就变得非常重要。我们通过比较在相同脉动摩擦下的欠阻尼和过阻尼朗之万动力学并满足共同温度下的脉动-耗散关系来研究这个问题。我们表明，与速度弛豫相比，当环境波动较快时，环境平均和惯性消除通常会导致不同的长时间传输。对于快速波动的摩擦，欠阻尼动力学由算术平均摩擦控制并产生 $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langle\gamma\rangle$，而过阻尼动力学给出 $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langle\gamma^{-1}\rangle$。对于二态马尔可夫摩擦，我们精确地推导了有限时间有效扩散系数，并确定了这两种状态之间的完全交叉，这是由速度弛豫和环境切换之间的竞争控制的。

我们进一步建立了一般平稳摩擦过程的快速波动结果，并在连续 log-Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 环境中验证了它，其特征交叉时间也可以独立确定。我们的结果揭示了环境平均和惯性消除之间的不可交换性，为时间异质环境中过阻尼动力学的有效性建立了一个与时间尺度相关的标准，并表明快速的环境波动可以增强而不是抑制惯性的后果。

title: Mean-field theory for quantum spin chains
abstract: Mean-field theory is a widely used approximation for describing phase transitions, particularly effective above the upper critical dimension. Its origins can be traced back to the van der Waals theory of the liquid-gas transition and Weiss's molecular field theory of the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition. However, it was Lev D. Landau who provided a unifying and general framework applicable to a broad class of physical systems. The mean-field approach typically involves neglecting thermal fluctuations, which is a reasonable assumption in many classical contexts. However, its application to quantum phase transitions at zero temperature is less common. The aim of this short pedagogical paper is to explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach in the less familiar domain of quantum phase transitions. We specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model.
summary: 平均场理论是一种广泛使用的描述相变的近似方法，在上临界尺寸以上特别有效。它的起源可以追溯到范德华的液-气转变理论和韦斯的顺磁-铁磁转变分子场理论。然而，Lev D. Landau 提供了一个适用于广泛的物理系统的统一的通用框架。平均场方法通常涉及忽略热波动，这在许多经典背景下是一个合理的假设。然而，它在零温度量子相变中的应用并不常见。这篇简短的教学论文的目的是探索和阐明平均场方法在不太熟悉的量子相变领域的使用。我们特别考虑 Ising 模型和 Blume-Capel 模型。

title: Scaling laws and energy dissipation in the dynamics of SLE curve as a 1D turbulence model
abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the characteristics of the stochastic Loewner evolution (SLE) as a one-dimensional (1D) turbulence model. First, we show that the diffusion process $x(t)$ obtained by the time coordinate change in the SLE becomes the time dependent diffusion process that satisfies Richardson's law of this http URL , we derive the condition on the diffusivity parameter $\kappa$ such that the diffusion process $x(t)$ satisfies Kolmogorov's 4/5th law, which determines the relation between the mean energy dissipation and velocity in the particles of turbulence. Further mathematical analysis showed that this condition is seen as the condition on Loewner entropy $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$, which includes the white Gaussian noise term $W_{s}$ in the Loewner driving function of the present model. In addition, the numerical simulations were performed to verify the scaling relations of this 1D turbulence model. These results suggest that the standard SLE becomes a beneficial model of 1D turbulence by introducing an appropriate time coordinate change and imposing the conditions on $\kappa$ and $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$.
summary: 在本研究中，我们展示了随机 Loewner 演化 (SLE) 作为一维 (1D) 湍流模型的特征。首先，我们证明SLE中通过时间坐标变化得到的扩散过程$x(t)$成为满足该http URL的理查森定律的时间相关扩散过程，我们推导了扩散率参数$\kappa$的条件，使得扩散过程$x(t)$满足柯尔莫哥洛夫4/5定律，该定律确定了湍流粒子中的平均能量耗散与速度之间的关系。进一步的数学分析表明，该条件被视为Loewner熵$S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$的条件，其中包括本模型Loewner驱动函数中的白高斯噪声项$W_{s}$。此外，还进行了数值模拟来验证该一维湍流模型的比例关系。这些结果表明，通过引入适当的时间坐标变化并对 $\kappa$ 和 $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$ 施加条件，标准 SLE 成为一维湍流的有益模型。

title: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
abstract: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.
summary:
识别电子-电子和电子-空穴对凝聚体的超流体刚度的起源是平带物理学中的一个重要问题。在这里，我们使用精确的对角化和真实的库仑相互作用来研究双层激子凝聚体的刚度，这些相互作用跨越各种平坦的陈能带系统，包括朗道能级、混合朗道能级和莫尔带。我们发现，刚度在量子度量的迹中是非单调的，并且当带波函数被设计为与朗道能级相似时，它会出现峰值。在这些最佳情况下，平均场理论预测的刚度在数量上与精确对角化一致，但在其他情况下系统地高估了它。具有相同量子几何张量的平带可以表现出显着的刚度差异。莫尔平带之间形成的凝聚体的刚度通常在布里渊区的贝里曲率和量子度量上有很大的变化，当带具有非零陈数时，其刚度往往会更大，并且可能大于朗道能级。

我们的结果揭示了比简单几何边界所暗示的行为更丰富的行为，并为具有大超流体刚度的鲁棒平带凝聚体的设计提供了新的指导原则。

title: Thermodynamic learning
abstract: We discuss the possibility to train a thermodynamic system, whose micro-variables are fully determined through the Hamiltonian by the usual statistical mechanical rules, to perform tasks such as memorization and generalization. Training is achieved by the application of suitable external fields, playing the role of {\it data}. At variance with conventional machine learning, no other logical or algorithmic rules are introduced. The system is amenable, in principle, to exact analytical calculations. We specialize this general approach to a prototypical Ising system with annealed dichotomous couplings and study its learning ability. Results indicate excellent memorization and good generalization capacity already for small systems, and a tendency to improve with system size.
summary: 我们讨论了训练热力学系统的可能性，该系统的微观变量完全由哈密顿量根据通常的统计力学规则确定，以执行诸如记忆和泛化等任务。训练是通过应用合适的外部场来实现的，扮演{\it data}的角色。与传统机器学习不同的是，没有引入其他逻辑或算法规则。原则上，该系统适合精确的分析计算。我们将这种通用方法专门用于具有退火二分耦合的原型 Ising 系统，并研究其学习能力。结果表明，小型系统已经具有出色的记忆力和良好的泛化能力，并且有随着系统规模而提高的趋势。

title: Field-Driven Coupled Magnon--Phonon--Electron Relaxation in Magnetite Using Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamic Formalism
abstract: A field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) formulation is developed for longitudinal nonequilibrium relaxation in magnetite (Fe$_3$O$_4$) with coupled electron, phonon, and magnon populations. Material-specific excitation spectra define the thermodynamic state space, while one relaxation parameter for each population sets its kinetic scale. A longitudinal magnetic field shifts the dressed magnon eigenenergies while the occupation basis remains fixed; irreversible redistribution conserves instantaneous energy and electron number while allowing the magnon population to vary. The formulation yields nonequilibrium subsystem temperatures, entropy production, magnetic-work identities, and a coupled small-signal susceptibility incorporating energy-conservation feedback among all three populations; the one-pole Debye response appears only as a limiting case. Numerical results under sinusoidal driving show a transition from nearly quasistatic behavior to frequency-dependent lag, finite-amplitude departure from the linear-response ellipse, and increasing higher-harmonic content. Relaxational work per cycle increases strongly with field amplitude and frequency, while the complex susceptibility is broader and shifted relative to a Debye reference. Entropy production remains positive, and the electron, phonon, and magnon temperatures show distinct excursions followed by secular heating when positive magnetic work is retained without heat rejection. The calculated work represents longitudinal magnon quasiparticle relaxation in a homogeneous single-domain model, not the total core loss of a finite ferrite specimen.
summary:
开发了一种场驱动的最速熵上升量子热力学 (SEAQT) 公式，用于耦合电子、声子和磁子群体的磁铁矿 (Fe$_3$O$_4$) 中的纵向非平衡弛豫。特定材料的激发光谱定义了热力学状态空间，而每个总体的一个弛豫参数设置了其动力学尺度。纵向磁场改变了修饰磁振子的本征能，而占据基础保持固定；不可逆的重新分配可以保存瞬时能量和电子数量，同时允许磁振子数量发生变化。该公式产生非平衡子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式以及结合所有三个群体之间的能量守恒反馈的耦合小信号磁化率；单极德拜响应仅作为一种极限情况出现。正弦驱动下的数值结果显示了从近准静态行为到频率相关滞后、与线性响应椭圆的有限幅度偏离以及高次谐波含量增加的转变。

每个周期的弛豫功随着场振幅和频率的增加而强烈增加，而复数磁化率相对于德拜参考更宽且发生偏移。熵产生保持正值，并且当保留正磁功而没有热排斥时，电子、声子和磁振子温度显示出明显的偏移，随后长期加热。计算出的功代表均匀单域模型中的纵向磁振子准粒子弛豫，而不是有限铁氧体样本的总磁芯损耗。

title: Spin-Charge Subordination in the Infinite-$U$ $SU(N)$ Hubbard Chain
abstract: We obtain the exact full counting statistics of charge and flavor transport in the one-dimensional infinite-$U$ $SU(N)$ Hubbard model. The no-passing constraint freezes the ordered flavor sequence while the particle coordinates evolve as free spinless fermions. Consequently, charge transfer is governed by a free-fermion determinant, whereas flavor transfer is exactly subordinated to the number of particles crossing the observation cut. For an arbitrary traceless Cartan generator this yields an exact relation between the charge and flavor cumulants. The complete asymptotic flavor distribution is a universal non-Gaussian M-Wright law. Together, these results establish spin--charge subordination as a kinematic mechanism for anomalously slow internal-state transport in one-dimensional impenetrable quantum gases.
summary: 我们在一维无限 $U$ $SU(N)$ Hubbard 模型中获得了电荷和风味传输的精确完整计数统计。不可通过约束冻结有序风味序列，而粒子坐标演化为自由无自旋费米子。因此，电荷转移由自由费米子决定因素控制，而风味转移完全取决于穿过观察切口的粒子数量。对于任意无痕嘉当发生器，这会产生电荷和风味累积量之间的精确关系。完整的渐近风味分布是通用的非高斯 M-赖特定律。总之，这些结果将自旋电荷从属关系确立为一维不可穿透的量子气体中异常缓慢的内态传输的运动学机制。

title: The elasticity of semiflexible polymers with reversible spontaneous curvature in two dimensions
abstract: Many semiflexible filaments exhibit structural asymmetries that lead to a curved ground state (curvature in the absence of thermal fluctuations, external forces, or torques). This property is known as spontaneous curvature. Many semiflexible polymers can reversibly develop spontaneous curvature through internal conformational transitions or through transient interactions with their molecular environment. In this article, we show that such reversible spontaneous curvature, even in the absence of transitions in the value of the bending stiffness, provides a minimal mechanism for ensemble-dependent elasticity. We formulate an analytically tractable two-state modified wormlike-chain model in two dimensions, in which an uncurved state (without spontaneous curvature) competes with a curved state (possessing spontaneous curvature). The transition is controlled by an activation energy. Within the weak-bending approximation, we obtain the Gibbs and Helmholtz partition functions for a stretched filament with reversible constant (uniform along the backbone) or sinusoidal spontaneous curvature and for a grafted bistable filament driven either by an end torque or a bending force. Stretching or bending induces a crossover from spontaneous-curvature-dominated to entropic elasticity. We show how the elastic response differs in the two ensembles (Gibbs vs Helmholtz). In addition, we consider the case where the curved state is also characterized by a higher value of the bending stiffness. In that case, a reentrant transition is possible as we stretch the bistable filament.
summary:
许多半柔性细丝表现出结构不对称，导致弯曲的基态（没有热波动、外力或扭矩的情况下的曲率）。这种性质被称为自发曲率。许多半柔性聚合物可以通过内部构象转变或通过与其分子环境的瞬时相互作用而可逆地形成自发曲率。在本文中，我们表明，即使在弯曲刚度值没有转变的情况下，这种可逆自发曲率也为依赖于整体的弹性提供了最小机制。我们在二维中制定了一种可分析处理的二态修正蠕虫链模型，其中非弯曲状态（没有自发曲率）与弯曲状态（具有自发曲率）竞争。该转变由活化能控制。在弱弯曲近似中，我们获得了具有可逆常数（沿主干均匀）或正弦自发曲率的拉伸细丝以及由端部扭矩或弯曲力驱动的接枝双稳态细丝的吉布斯和亥姆霍兹配分函数。

拉伸或弯曲会导致从自发曲率主导到熵弹性的交叉。我们展示了两个系综（吉布斯 vs 亥姆霍兹）中弹性响应的差异。此外，我们还考虑弯曲状态还具有较高弯曲刚度值的情况。在这种情况下，当我们拉伸双稳态细丝时，可能会发生重入转变。

title: Spin-Point-Group Classification of Multipoles for Nonrelativistic Collinear Magnets
abstract: Multipole moments provide a unified symmetry language for describing electronic degrees of freedom and their associated physical responses. Although active multipoles have been systematically classified for crystallographic and magnetic point groups, their classification in spin point groups, which naturally describe magnetic systems in the absence of spin-orbit coupling, has remained unexplored. In this work, we present a complete classification of active orbital and spin multipoles for all 32 nonmagnetic and 122 collinear spin point groups. Treating orbital and spin degrees of freedom independently, we identify the symmetry-allowed multipoles associated with nonmagnetic and collinear magnetic orderings and clarify their hierarchy through comparisons among the corresponding spin point groups. The resulting classification provides a symmetry-based database that distinguishes structural and magnetic contributions to active multipoles and directly identifies microscopic order parameters, including those responsible for $d$-, $g$-, and $i$-wave altermagnetism. Furthermore, by classifying response tensors within the same framework, we establish a correspondence between active multipoles and symmetry-allowed physical responses. This correspondence systematically distinguishes nonrelativistic responses that survive without spin-orbit coupling from those requiring relativistic effects, providing a unified framework for understanding and predicting spin-dependent electromagnetic and transport phenomena in magnetic materials.
summary:
多极矩提供了一种统一的对称语言来描述电子自由度及其相关的物理响应。尽管主动多极子已经被系统地分类为晶体学和磁点群，但它们在自旋点群中的分类仍然未被探索，自旋点群自然地描述了没有自旋轨道耦合的磁系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了所有 32 个非磁性和 122 个共线自旋点组的主动轨道和自旋多极子的完整分类。独立处理轨道和自旋自由度，我们识别了与非磁性和共线磁序相关的对称允许的多极，并通过相应自旋点组之间的比较来阐明它们的层次结构。由此产生的分类提供了一个基于对称性的数据库，可区分对主动多极的结构和磁性贡献，并直接识别微观有序参数，包括那些负责 $d$-、$g$- 和 $i$-波交变磁性的参数。

此外，通过在同一框架内对响应张量进行分类，我们在主动多极子和对称允许的物理响应之间建立了对应关系。这种对应关系系统地将无需自旋轨道耦合而存在的非相对论响应与需要相对论效应的非相对论响应区分开来，为理解和预测磁性材料中自旋相关的电磁和输运现象提供了统一的框架。

title: Bias-field control of the Neel skyrmion nonlinearity in a confined nanostructure
abstract: We study the nonlinear dynamics of a cylindrical skyrmion-based oscillator within the framework of a generalized Thiele model. We demonstrate the influence of an bias magnetic field applied perpendicular to the plane of the nanocylinder on the oscillation frequency and on the nonlinearity coefficient. It is shown that the field tunes the response frequency, while also producing a substantial change in the nonlinear frequency shift. We find that the nonlinearity coefficient reverses its sign as the field crosses a certain critical value. The variation of the nonlinearity coefficient with the field is clearly illustrated by the observed qualitative changes in nonlinear amplitude-frequency responses. Controlling the nonlinear properties of a skyrmion oscillator by changing the bias magnetic field opens up prospects for creating tunable computational elements for neuromorphic applications.
summary: 我们在广义蒂勒模型的框架内研究了基于斯格明子的圆柱形振荡器的非线性动力学。我们证明了垂直于纳米圆柱体平面施加的偏置磁场对振荡频率和非线性系数的影响。结果表明，场调整了响应频率，同时也产生了非线性频移的显着变化。我们发现当场超过某个临界值时，非线性系数的符号会反转。非线性幅频响应中观察到的定性变化清楚地说明了非线性系数随场的变化。通过改变偏置磁场来控制斯格明子振荡器的非线性特性，为神经形态应用创建可调谐计算元件开辟了前景。

title: Anomalous diffusion in porous fractal media
abstract: We suggest a model of a diffusive process inside a fractal sponge structure, which is a generalization of the diffusion processes on a comb and fractal mesh structure. The sponge model is considered as the direct product of Cantor sets. It is shown that the corresponding one-dimensional diffusion process is governed by a generalized Fokker-Planck equation with a power-law memory kernel and a position-dependent diffusion coefficient. That is, the fractal structure of the medium induces memory effects and heterogeneity in the transport system. The considered model may be of interest to describe anomalous heat transport in porous fractal media.
summary: 我们提出了分形海绵结构内部扩散过程的模型，它是梳状和分形网格结构上扩散过程的概括。海绵模型被认为是康托集的直接产物。结果表明，相应的一维扩散过程由具有幂律记忆核和位置相关扩散系数的广义福克-普朗克方程控制。也就是说，介质的分形结构会引起运输系统的记忆效应和异质性。所考虑的模型可能有助于描述多孔分形介质中的反常热传输。

title: Local coordination, structural softening, and polarization-switching energetics in Sc-alloyed GaN
abstract: Sc-alloyed wurtzite nitrides exhibit strongly tunable electromechanical and ferroelectric properties, yet the relationship between their lattice evolution and local bonding environment remains insufficiently established, particularly in Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N. Here, we investigate the structural and local bonding evolution of Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N across the dilute-to-intermediate composition range by combining X-ray diffraction, Sc K-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES), extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) and first-principles calculations. Sc incorporation produces an anisotropic lattice expansion and a progressive reduction in the c/a ratio. XANES and EXAFS reveal a concurrent modification of the local environment around Sc, with the effective Sc-N coordination number increasing from 4.1(4) to 4.5(2) and the average Sc-N bond length increasing from 2.045(7) to 2.081(8)Å over x=0.06-0.26. The local response is accompanied by a reduction in the Sc K-edge pre-edge intensity, consistent with a gradual reduction of the local tetrahedral asymmetry. First-principles calculations show that these structural changes are associated with site-selective distortions around Sc and progressive flattening of the structural energy landscape. The calculated intrinsic polarization-switching barrier decreases from 24.2 to 19.0 meV/Å$^3$ with increasing Sc content, while the calculated piezoelectric stress coefficient (e$_{33}$) increases from 0.82 to 1.66~C/m$^2$ and elastic constant (C$_{33}$) decreases from 380 to 227~GPa, resulting in an increase of piezoelectric strain coefficient (d$_{33}$) from 2.99 to 12.46~pC/N. These results show that Sc incorporation progressively modifies the local coordination environment and structural energetics of ScGaN while the long-range wurtzite structure remains preserved over the investigated composition range.
summary:
Sc合金纤锌矿氮化物表现出强烈可调的机电和铁电性能，但其晶格演化与局部键合环境之间的关系仍未充分建立，特别是在Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N中。在这里，我们通过结合 X 射线衍射、Sc K 边缘 X 射线吸收近边缘结构 (XANES)、扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 和第一性原理计算，研究了 Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N 在稀至中间成分范围内的结构和局部成键演化。 Sc 的掺入会产生各向异性的晶格膨胀和 c/a 比率的逐渐降低。 XANES 和 EXAFS 揭示了 Sc 周围局部环境的同时改变，在 x=0.06-0.26 范围内，有效 Sc-N 配位数从 4.1(4) 增加到 4.5(2)，平均 Sc-N 键长从 2.045(7) 增加到 2.081(8)Å。局部响应伴随着 Sc K 边缘预边缘强度的降低，与局部四面体不对称性的逐渐降低一致。

第一性原理计算表明，这些结构变化与 Sc 周围的选址扭曲和结构能源景观的逐渐扁平化有关。随着Sc含量的增加，计算出的本征极化转换势垒从24.2 meV/Å$^3$减小到19.0 meV/Å$^3$，而计算出的压电应力系数(e$_{33}$)从0.82增加到1.66~C/m$^2$，弹性常数(C$_{33}$)从380减小到227~GPa，导致压电应变系数(d$_{33}$)增加从 2.99 到 12.46~pC/N。这些结果表明，Sc 的掺入逐渐改变了 ScGaN 的局部配位环境和结构能量学，而长程纤锌矿结构在研究的成分范围内保持不变。

title: ANT:UI: An interactive 3D tool for preparing ANT.Gaussian molecular junction geometries
abstract: this http URL is a Python graphical interface that automates the construction of molecular-junction geometries for NEGF-DFT quantum transport calculations. Through a real-time 3D viewer, users interactively position electrodes and molecules and generate complete, ready-to-run input files for Gaussian and this http URL without manual scripting. Dedicated Pull, Grid, and Rotation assistants further automate electrode-pulling sequences, surface scans, and step-wise rotation studies, with optional geometry-optimisation chaining across each sequence. By replacing a process that previously demanded days of custom scripting with a point-and-click workflow, this http URL accelerates research in theoretical molecular electronics and lowers the barrier to entry for new users. The software also exports all constructed geometries in standard XYZ format, allowing direct reuse in molecular dynamics codes or third-party visualization tools without manual reformatting.
summary: 此 http URL 是一个 Python 图形界面，可自动构建用于 NEGF-DFT 量子输运计算的分子结几何结构。通过实时 3D 查看器，用户可以交互地定位电极和分子，并为 Gaussian 和此 http URL 生成完整的、可立即运行的输入文件，无需手动编写脚本。专用的拉动、网格和旋转助手进一步自动化电极拉动序列、表面扫描和逐步旋转研究，并在每个序列之间提供可选的几何优化链接。通过用点击式工作流程取代以前需要数天自定义脚本的流程，此 http URL 加速了理论分子电子学的研究，并降低了新用户的进入门槛。该软件还以标准 XYZ 格式导出所有构建的几何形状，允许在分子动力学代码或第三方可视化工具中直接重复使用，而无需手动重新格式化。

title: Tensor-Network Inference in a Field-Coupled XY Model for Portfolio Allocation
abstract: We apply tensor-network methods to a field-coupled XY model for long-only portfolio construction. Daily return statistics set asset-specific fields and correlation couplings. Correlation distance, four-point Gromov hyperbolicity, and Ward clustering are used to construct a sparse interaction path. A Fourier-Bessel expansion maps the continuous angular partition function to a finite-current tensor network; bottom-up and top-down contractions then give the one-site marginals and equilibrium cosine scores. A softmax map converts these scores into positive, fully invested portfolio weights. We study five equity markets over continuous ranges of inverse temperature beta and concentration gamma, and compare selected parameter pairs with long-only Markowitz frontiers and standard benchmarks. The same-sample comparisons demonstrate a tractable route from financial time series to network-adjusted allocations; predictive trading performance is outside their scope.
summary: 我们将张量网络方法应用于场耦合 XY 模型，以构建多头投资组合。每日收益统计设置资产特定字段和相关性耦合。使用相关距离、四点 Gromov 双曲性和 Ward 聚类来构建稀疏交互路径。傅里叶-贝塞尔展开将连续角度分配函数映射到有限电流张量网络；自下而上和自上而下的收缩然后给出单点边际和平衡余弦分数。 Softmax 映射将这些分数转换为正的、完全投资的投资组合权重。我们在反温度贝塔和浓度伽马的连续范围内研究了五个股票市场，并将选定的参数对与仅多头马科维茨前沿和标准基准进行比较。相同样本的比较证明了从金融时间序列到网络调整分配的易于处理的路线；预测交易表现超出了他们的范围。

title: Influence of dislocation density on the tribological response in oxides: case study on SrTiO3
abstract: Most ceramics suffer from brittle surface damage and cracking when small particles slide across the surface under low load. Microscratching tests are a useful technique to mimic this loading scenario while retaining the material's deformation history; however, the impact of pre-seeded dislocations, which can significantly facilitate plastic deformation, has not been explored in ceramics. Here, the influence of mechanically seeded dislocations on the microscratching response of oxides is investigated using a model perovskite, SrTiO3. First, various dislocation densities over four orders of magnitude are introduced via room-temperature cyclic Brinell indenter scratching. Subsequently, load-ramped microscratching tests are performed within the pristine and dislocation-seeded regions using a nominally 30 {\mu}m spherical diamond tip. On the reference pristine surface, we observe a clear transition from elastic to elasto-plastic deformation, followed by median/radial cracking at higher loads. In contrast, pre-seeded dislocations, accompanied by residual compressive stresses, suppress elastic deformation and lead to median/radial crack shortening and subsequent transition to a partial cone crack. The subsurface cracks are characterized by 3D Nano-CT. The changes in crack geometry, with and without dislocations, were described using the Lawn-Evans-Marshall and Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts models. These findings provide direct evidence of dislocation-regulated near-surface damage tolerance, with general applicability to other plastically deformable oxides.
summary:
当小颗粒在低负载下滑过表面时，大多数陶瓷都会遭受脆性表面损伤和破裂。微划痕测试是一种有用的技术，可以模拟这种加载场景，同时保留材料的变形历史；然而，陶瓷中尚未探讨可显着促进塑性变形的预种位错的影响。在这里，使用钙钛矿模型 SrTiO3 研究了机械播种位错对氧化物微划痕响应的影响。首先，通过室温循环布氏压头划痕引入超过四个数量级的各种位错密度。随后，使用标称 30 μm 球形金刚石尖端在原始区域和位错播种区域内进行负载斜坡微划痕测试。在参考原始表面上，我们观察到从弹性变形到弹塑性变形的明显转变，然后在较高载荷下出现中值/径向裂纹。

相反，预种位错伴随着残余压应力，抑制弹性变形并导致中值/径向裂纹缩短并随后转变为部分锥体裂纹。表面下裂纹通过 3D Nano-CT 进行表征。使用 Lawn-Evans-Marshall 和 Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts 模型描述了有或没有位错的裂纹几何形状的变化。这些发现提供了位错调节的近表面损伤容限的直接证据，并且普遍适用于其他塑性变形氧化物。

title: Generalized Helicity-Dependent Magnetization Switching via Substrate Phonons
abstract: Coherent excitation of circularly-polarized substrate phonons can drive deterministic reversal of magnetization in an adjacent magnetic layer. However, the extent to which this substrate-mediated mechanism can be generalized across different materials remains unresolved. Here, we measure and compare the spectral dependence of helicity-dependent magnetization reversal in magnetic GdFeCo layers grown on a diverse set of diamagnetic substrates. Switching is observed for all investigated substrates, spanning six point groups and several infrared-active transverse-optical phonon symmetries. While the switching spectra broadly overlap with the Reststrahlen bands, their maxima are systematically shifted to wavelengths shorter than the corresponding transverse-optical phonon resonances. This spectral mismatch shows that substrate absorption alone does not determine the switching efficiency. Transfer-matrix calculations show that strong absorption concentrates energy deposition near the substrate interface, providing a possible source of local heating that could suppress magnetization reversal. Our results reveal the broad applicability of substrate-mediated phononic switching while showing that its efficiency is governed by the full optical response of the heterostructure rather than substrate absorption alone.
summary:
圆偏振基底声子的相干激发可以驱动相邻磁性层中磁化强度的确定性反转。然而，这种底物介导的机制在不同材料中的推广程度仍未解决。在这里，我们测量并比较了在不同的反磁性基底上生长的磁性 GdFeCo 层中螺旋性相关的磁化反转的光谱依赖性。所有研究的基底都观察到切换，跨越六个点组和几个红外活性横向光学声子对称性。虽然切换光谱与 Reststrahlen 频带广泛重叠，但它们的最大值系统地转移到比相应的横向光学声子共振更短的波长。这种光谱不匹配表明衬底吸收本身并不能决定开关效率。转移矩阵计算表明，强吸收将能量沉积集中在基板界面附近，提供了可能的局部加热源，可以抑制磁化反转。

我们的结果揭示了基底介导的声子开关的广泛适用性，同时表明其效率是由异质结构的完整光学响应而不是单独的基底吸收决定的。

title: Cross-Layer Anomalous Hall Transport driven by Néel-Vector rotating in the Altermagnet candidate V2Te2O
abstract: In van der Waals (vdW) materials, weak interlayer coupling generally suppresses vertical dispersion, reinforcing the conventional paradigm that in-plane transport dominates over cross-layer channels. Here, using first-principles calculations and magnetic symmetry analyses, we uncover a giant, symmetry-unlocked cross-layer anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in the vdW altermagnet V2Te2O. In the magnetic ground state with Neel vector N//z, horizontal mirror symmetry protects a spin-polarized nodal chain near the Fermi level and strictly enforces zero anomalous Hall response. Tilting the Neel vector explicitly breaks this mirror protection, allowing spin-orbit coupling to gap the nodal chain and activate a sharp cross-layer Hall response. When the Neel vector is rotated into the in-plane configuration (N//x), cross-layer orbital hybridization generates intensive Berry curvature hotspots, boosting the cross-layer component of AHC {\sigma}_{yz} to approximately 255 S/cm, which exceeds in-plane component {\sigma}_{xy} by nearly two orders of magnitude. Furthermore, varying the azimuthal angle systematically redistributes the anomalous Hall response, enabling full directional control of transverse transport. Our findings demonstrate a highly sensitive cross-layer anomalous Hall switch activated by low-barrier spin canting, offering promising avenues for directional tensor selection and low-power multi-axial vdW spintronics.
summary:
在范德华（vdW）材料中，弱层间耦合通常会抑制垂直色散，从而强化了面内传输优于跨层通道的传统范例。在这里，利用第一性原理计算和磁对称分析，我们在 vdW 交变磁体 V2Te2O 中发现了一个巨大的、对称性解锁的跨层反常霍尔电导率 (AHC)。在尼尔矢量 N//z 的磁基态中，水平镜像对称性保护费米能级附近的自旋极化节点链，并严格执行零反常霍尔响应。倾斜尼尔矢量明确打破了这种镜子保护，允许自旋轨道耦合间隙节点链并激活尖锐的跨层霍尔响应。当尼尔矢量旋转到面内构型（N//x）时，跨层轨道杂化会产生密集的贝里曲率热点，将AHC {\sigma}_{yz} 的跨层分量提高到大约255 S/cm，这超出了面内分量{\sigma}_{xy} 近两个数量级。

此外，改变方位角可以系统地重新分布异常霍尔响应，从而实现横向传输的全面定向控制。我们的研究结果证明了一种由低势垒自旋倾斜激活的高度灵敏的跨层反常霍尔开关，为定向张量选择和低功耗多轴 vdW 自旋电子学提供了有前景的途径。

title: Symmetry-protected triplet Weyl complexes
abstract: The Nielsen-Ninomiya theorem dictates that Weyl nodes must appear in pairs of opposite chirality to preserve global charge neutrality. However, in crystals, specific crystalline symmetries can stabilize multi-Weyl nodes, circumventing this pairwise constraint and enabling compensated Weyl complexes with mixed chiral charges. The minimal configuration of this type is a triplet Weyl complex (TWC), comprising exactly three Weyl nodes. Here, we systematically investigate the symmetry conditions required to realize TWCs. By screening all 1651 magnetic space groups (MSGs) in both spinless and spinful systems, we establish that: (i) Only TWCs with charge magnitudes of $\{1,1,2\}$ and $\{1,2,3\}$ are permitted; (ii) the $\{1,1,2\}$ configuration can be realized in 166 spinless MSGs and 70 spinful MSGs; and (iii) the $\{1,2,3\}$-TWCs, which has not been reported before, can occur in 10 MSGs for both spinless and spinful cases. We explicitly demonstrate the existence of $\{1,2,3\}$-TWC in a tight-binding model. Furthermore, we present the first electronic realization of $\{1,1,2\}$-TWC topological semimetal state in the chiral carbon allotrope DZQH-C$_{36}$, in which the three Weyl nodes form a collinear configuration, leading to a characteristic ``S''-shaped surface Fermi arc pattern. Our findings uncover novel topological states featuring mixed chiral charges and provide guidance for exploring their physics in concrete material systems.
summary:
尼尔森-二宫定理规定，Weyl 节点必须成对出现相反的手性，以保持全局电荷中性。然而，在晶体中，特定的晶体对称性可以稳定多外尔节点，绕过这种成对约束，并实现具有混合手性电荷的补偿外尔配合物。这种类型的最小配置是三重态 Weyl 复合体 (TWC)，仅包含三个 Weyl 节点。在这里，我们系统地研究了实现 TWC 所需的对称条件。通过筛选无自旋和自旋系统中的所有 1651 个磁空间群 (MSG)，我们确定： (i) 仅允许电荷量级为 $\{1,1,2\}$ 和 $\{1,2,3\}$ 的 TWC； (ii)$\{1,1,2\}$配置可以在166个无自旋MSG和70个自旋MSG中实现； (iii) $\{1,2,3\}$-TWC，以前没有报道过，在无旋转和旋转情况下，10 个 MSG 中都可能出现。我们明确证明了紧束缚模型中 $\{1,2,3\}$-TWC 的存在。

此外，我们在手性碳同素异形体 DZQH-C$_{36}$ 中首次实现了 $\{1,1,2\}$-TWC 拓扑半金属态，其中三个 Weyl 节点形成共线构型，从而形成特征性的“S”形表面费米弧图案。我们的研究结果揭示了具有混合手性电荷的新颖拓扑状态，并为探索混凝土材料系统中的物理现象提供了指导。

title: On the growth of operator entanglement in brickwork circuits with Yang--Baxter gates
abstract: We study the operator entanglement of local operators in one-dimensional brickwork circuits whose two-site gate satisfies the braid relation; throughout this work, we call such a gate a Yang--Baxter gate. We establish upper bounds for several structured, overlapping classes of Yang--Baxter gates. We show that the operator Schmidt rank remains uniformly bounded in time for all qubit Yang--Baxter gates and, in arbitrary local dimension, for permutation gates obtained from non-degenerate Yang--Baxter maps. We also show that it grows at most polynomially for involutive dual-unitary Yang--Baxter gates and for arbitrary phase dressings of permutation gates obtained from non-degenerate Yang--Baxter maps. These results imply, respectively, constant and logarithmic upper bounds on the operator entanglement. Conversely, we construct a seven-state involutive Yang--Baxter gate without dual unitarity and a one-site operator whose exact operator Schmidt rank grows exponentially, although the corresponding operator entropies remain undetermined. Entanglement growth in the general Yang--Baxter case remains open. All proofs and selected examples were constructed by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol.
summary: 研究了两点门满足辫子关系的一维砖砌电路中局部算子的算子纠缠；在整个工作中，我们将这样的门称为“Yang-Baxter 门”。我们为几个结构化的、重叠的 Yang-Baxter 门类别建立了上限。我们证明，对于所有量子位杨-巴克斯特门，以及在任意局部维度上，对于从非简并杨-巴克斯特映射获得的排列门，算子施密特等级在时间上保持一致有界。我们还表明，对于内合双酉杨-巴克斯特门和从非简并杨-巴克斯特映射获得的置换门的任意相修饰，它最多以多项式增长。这些结果分别意味着算子纠缠的常数和对数上限。相反，我们构造了一个没有对偶酉性的七态对合杨-巴克斯特门和一个单点算子，其精确的算子施密特等级呈指数增长，尽管相应的算子熵仍然不确定。杨-巴克斯特将军案中的纠缠增长仍然悬而未决。所有证明和选定的示例均由 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol 构建。

title: Environment-assisted transport in a strongly correlated boundary-driven Fermi-Hubbard chain
abstract: We study steady-state transport in a one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chain coupled to particle reservoirs at the boundaries and to local dephasing baths at each site, using the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) method to solve the Lindblad master equation. In the absence of dephasing, the current exhibits two well-separated maxima as a function of the boundary driving rate, reflecting the distinct charge and spin energy scales of the strongly correlated regime. Upon introducing dephasing, we find two distinct dephasing-induced transport-enhancement regimes, in contrast to the single enhancement previously reported for spinless fermions. Analysis of the non-equilibrium steady state in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis reveals that the two regimes originate from distinct dephasing-induced redistribution processes: the first involves redistribution within the uppermost Hubbard band, while the second involves transitions between Hubbard bands. Our results demonstrate how many-body correlations shape the interplay between coherent driving, dephasing, and quantum Zeno physics in strongly correlated open systems.
summary: 我们研究一维费米-哈伯德链中的稳态输运，该链与边界处的粒子库和每个位置的局部相移槽耦合，使用时间演化块抽取（TEBD）方法来求解 Lindblad 主方程。在没有相移的情况下，电流表现出两个分离良好的最大值作为边界驱动速率的函数，反映了强相关状态的不同电荷和自旋能尺度。在引入移相后，我们发现了两种不同的移相诱导的传输增强机制，这与之前报道的无自旋费米子的单一增强形成鲜明对比。对哈伯德本征基中的非平衡稳态的分析表明，这两种状态源于不同的相移引起的重新分布过程：第一种涉及最上面的哈伯德带内的重新分布，而第二种涉及哈伯德带之间的转变。我们的结果证明了多体相关性如何影响强相关开放系统中相干驱动、相干和量子芝诺物理之间的相互作用。

title: Glassy dynamics, crossover temperature and density scaling in fragile glass-formers
abstract: We investigate the slowing down of dynamics in a glass-forming mixture interacting via an inverse-power-law (IPL) potential using a combination of theory and large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We measure the static pair-correlation function, configurational entropy, inherent-structure energy, and structural relaxation time. We employ a theoretical framework to calculate the structural relaxation time $\tau_{\alpha}$, which is found to be in very good agreement with the simulation results. The theory identifies a local structural order which defines the cooperativity of the relaxation and brings forth a fluctuation induced parameter $\psi ( T )$ and a crossover temperature $T_a$ that characterize the density and temperature dependence of the glassy dynamics. Furthermore, we determine a crossover temperature using independent dynamical and thermodynamic criteria and compare with the theoretically predicted crossover temperature $T_a$. Relaxation dynamics is shown to obey density-temperature scaling, similar to thermodynamic properties, in terms of a variable $\Gamma$ formed by an appropriate combination of density and temperature, characteristic of IPL interactions. Finally, we show that, when the excess thermodynamic and dynamic quantities obtained at different densities are plotted as functions of the reduced temperature $T/T_a$ (or $T_a/T$), the data collapse onto master curves with excellent agreement between theory and simulation. These scaling relations provide a unified description of the thermodynamics and dynamics in IPL systems, enabling the prediction of relaxation behavior over a wide range of densities from data at a single state point.
summary:
我们结合理论和大规模分子动力学模拟，研究了通过反幂律 (IPL) 势相互作用的玻璃形成混合物中动力学的减慢。我们测量静态配对相关函数、构型熵、固有结构能量和结构弛豫时间。我们采用理论框架来计算结构弛豫时间$\tau_{\alpha}$，发现这与模拟结果非常吻合。该理论确定了局部结构顺序，该顺序定义了弛豫的协同性，并提出了波动诱导参数 $\psi ( T )$ 和交叉温度 $T_a$ ，它们表征了玻璃态动力学的密度和温度依赖性。此外，我们使用独立的动力学和热力学标准确定交叉温度，并与理论预测的交叉温度 $T_a$ 进行比较。弛豫动力学被证明服从密度-温度缩放，类似于热力学性质，就由密度和温度的适当组合形成的变量 $\Gamma$ 而言，这是 IPL 相互作用的特征。

最后，我们表明，当在不同密度下获得的过量热力学和动力学量被绘制为降低温度 $T/T_a$ （或 $T_a/T$）的函数时，数据崩溃到主曲线上，理论与模拟之间具有良好的一致性。这些标度关系提供了 IPL 系统中热力学和动力学的统一描述，从而能够根据单个状态点的数据预测各种密度下的弛豫行为。

title: Neural-field design of broadband Rayleigh-wave carpet cloaks under microstructure realisability constraints
abstract: Transformation elasticity provides appropriate material distributions for elastodynamic cloaks but the required stiffness tensors generally violate the minor symmetries of Cauchy elasticity and are difficult to realise using conventional materials. Existing approaches restore these symmetries by modifying the transformed tensor, producing only an approximate cloak. In this work rather than modifying the transformed tensor we seek the best performing cloak within the class of Cauchy materials. We formulate 2D Rayleigh wave carpet cloak design as an optimisation problem governed by partial differential equations. Using a coordinate based neural-field and a differentiable finite element model solver we optimise symmetric stiffness and density fields by minimising wave field distortion. Both single frequency and broadband optimisation are considered, with the broadband model trained over multiple frequencies. Physical realisability is addressed using a database of homogenised microstructures through conditional diffusion, neural-field inverse design, and nearest-neighbour selection. FEM simulations show that the optimised Cauchy design approaches the ideal transformation-based cloak. After projection onto explicit microstructures, the homogenised representation recovers approximately 97% of the defect free reference surface-displacement magnitude, while direct FEM simulation of the fully resolved microstructured geometry recovers approximately 76%
summary:
变换弹性为弹性动力斗篷提供了适当的材料分布，但所需的刚度张量通常违反柯西弹性的次要对称性，并且很难使用传统材料实现。现有的方法通过修改变换后的张量来恢复这些对称性，仅产生近似的斗篷。在这项工作中，我们不是修改变换后的张量，而是寻求柯西材料类中性能最佳的斗篷。我们将二维瑞利波地毯斗篷设计制定为由偏微分方程控制的优化问题。使用基于坐标的神经场和可微分有限元模型求解器，我们通过最小化波场畸变来优化对称刚度和密度场。考虑单频和宽带优化，并在多个频率上训练宽带模型。通过条件扩散、神经场逆设计和最近邻选择，使用均质微结构数据库来解决物理可实现性。有限元模拟表明，优化的柯西设计接近理想的基于变换的斗篷。

投影到显式微结构上后，均匀化表示可恢复约 97% 的无缺陷参考表面位移量级，而完全解析的微结构几何形状的直接 FEM 模拟可恢复约 76%

title: Transparency-engineered SQUID cells for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials
abstract: We introduce a transparency-engineered rf-SQUID cell for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials. This design replaces the conventional tunnel-junction element with an effective Josephson element formed by two junctions in series, yielding a non-sinusoidal energy-phase relation that can be used as a tunable nonlinear design resource. We show that the asymmetry between the two series junctions and the applied flux bias provide independent control over the local expansion of the rf-SQUID potential, enabling operating points where the leading quartic Kerr term is suppressed while the cubic nonlinearity remains finite. We derive the corresponding Kerr-free condition, identify the resulting operating ridge in parameter space, and analyze the local stability and passive-matching constraints that bound its physically accessible portion. Our results provide a compact unit-cell design principle for three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials and suggest a route toward Kerr-suppressed Josephson traveling-wave parametric amplifiers.
summary: 我们引入了一种用于无克尔三波混合约瑟夫森超材料的透明设计的 rf-SQUID 单元。该设计用由两个串联结形成的有效约瑟夫森元件取代了传统的隧道结元件，产生了可用作可调非线性设计资源的非正弦能量相位关系。我们表明，两个串联结之间的不对称性和所施加的磁通偏置提供了对 rf-SQUID 势的局部扩展的独立控制，从而实现了抑制前四次克尔项同时三次非线性保持有限的工作点。我们推导出相应的无克尔条件，识别参数空间中产生的操作脊，并分析限制其物理可访问部分的局部稳定性和被动匹配约束。我们的结果为三波混合约瑟夫森超材料提供了紧凑的单元设计原理，并提出了一条通往克尔抑制约瑟夫森行波参量放大器的路线。

title: Markov chains at the onset of non-reversibility
abstract: For a one-dimensional path graph and a lifted path graph constructed from a duplication of each of its sites, we study how a reversible Markov chain can be perturbed and gradually driven into non-reversibility. The reversible Markov chain has a transition matrix that is diagonalizable and features real-valued eigenvalues and eigenvectors. The left and right eigenvectors form a biorthogonal system. We discuss in concrete examples how the transition matrix of a non-reversible Markov chain may be diagonalizable or non-diagonalizable, and it may have real eigenvalues and complex-conjugate pairs. For a number of steady states (flat, square-wave, wedge, V-shape), we compute eigenvalue spectra on both graphs and discuss the speedup that can be achieved through lifting. We develop a Green's matrix formalism, which we use to compute Kemeny times and mean first-passage times, and which provides valuable information and allows us to interpret the results for the characteristic times.
summary: 对于一维路径图和由每个站点的副本构造的提升路径图，我们研究了如何扰动可逆马尔可夫链并逐渐使其变得不可逆。可逆马尔可夫链具有可对角化的转移矩阵，并具有实值特征值和特征向量。左右特征向量形成双正交系统。我们通过具体例子讨论不可逆马尔可夫链的转移矩阵如何可对角化或不可对角化，并且它可以具有实数特征值和复共轭对。对于许多稳态（平坦、方波、楔形、V 形），我们计算两个图上的特征值谱，并讨论通过提升可以实现的加速。我们开发了格林矩阵形式，用于计算 Kemeny 时间和平均首次通过时间，并提供有价值的信息并使我们能够解释特征时间的结果。

title: Ni-O hybridization as a stabilizer for $s^{\pm}$ superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$: a DFT+RPA study
abstract: The superconducting gap symmetry of high-pressure bilayer nickelates remains under debate, with weak- and strong-coupling approaches yielding different pairing tendencies. In this work, we investigate how the weak-coupling treatment of electronic states away from the Fermi level influences magnetic fluctuations and superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. We employ a full-spectrum model based on orthonormalized projections of Kohn-Sham states onto local Ni-$e_g$ orbitals, which preserves the density-functional band structure while redistributing spectral weight over a wide energy range. Compared to a low-energy description, this approach yields enhanced interlayer spin fluctuations and a commensurate magnetic instability. Within a spin-fluctuation framework, these features favor a sign-changing $s^\pm$ superconducting state, whereas low-energy models tend to stabilize $d$-wave pairing. Our results suggest that interlayer coupling in full-energy models may play an important role in shaping the predicted pairing symmetry of bilayer nickelates.
summary: 高压双层镍酸盐的超导带隙对称性仍然存在争议，弱耦合和强耦合方法会产生不同的配对倾向。在这项工作中，我们研究了远离费米能级的电子态的弱耦合处理如何影响 La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ 中的磁涨落和超导性。我们采用基于 Kohn-Sham 态到局部 Ni-$e_g$ 轨道的正交化投影的全谱模型，该模型保留了密度泛函能带结构，同时在较宽的能量范围内重新分配谱权重。与低能量描述相比，这种方法产生增强的层间自旋波动和相应的磁不稳定性。在自旋涨落框架内，这些特征有利于符号变化的 $s^\pm$ 超导态，而低能模型则倾向于稳定 $d$ 波配对。我们的结果表明，全能模型中的层间耦合可能在塑造双层镍盐的预测配对对称性方面发挥重要作用。

title: Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element
abstract: Two conventional Josephson junctions connected in series can reproduce, in the static limit in which the currents through the capacitive and resistive channels are negligible, the current-phase relation of a single effective weak link with tunable transparency. Therefore, the two-junction series can be treated as a single synthetic high-transparency element. Here, we investigate to what extent this mapping remains valid under finite-frequency drive and retaining the junctions' resistive and capacitive terms. The full resistively and capacitively shunted junction equations are compared with an effective synthetic element with tunable transparency that retains the synthetic tunable-transparency current-phase relation together with effective capacitive and dissipative terms, thus reducing the two second order degree of freedom system to a single second order degree of freedom. The resulting single-element dynamics is compared with the complete two-junction system under ac excitation. The agreement is quantified through a normalized root-mean-square error between the full and effective voltage waveforms. A broad low-error region is found at low drive frequency, while pronounced deviations emerge as the drive frequency approaches the relevant plasma-frequency scale and at larger drive amplitudes. The results provide a quantitative dynamical criterion for using the reduced single-element description of a synthetic high-transparency Josephson element in superconducting circuits.
summary:
串联连接的两个传统约瑟夫森结可以在通过电容性和电阻性通道的电流可忽略不计的静态极限下再现具有可调透明度的单个有效弱连接的电流-相位关系。因此，双结系列可以被视为单个合成高透明度元件。在这里，我们研究了这种映射在有限频率驱动下保持有效的程度，并保留了结点的电阻和电容项。将全电阻和电容分流结方程与具有可调透明度的有效合成元件进行比较，该元件保留了合成可调透明度电流相位关系以及有效电容和耗散项，从而将两个二阶自由度系统减少到单个二阶自由度。将所得的单元件动力学与交流激励下的完整两结系统进行比较。该一致性通过完整电压波形和有效电压波形之间的归一化均方根误差来量化。

在低驱动频率下发现了一个广泛的低误差区域，而当驱动频率接近相关等离子体频率范围和在较大的驱动幅度时，会出现明显的偏差。结果为在超导电路中使用合成高透明度约瑟夫森元件的简化单元件描述提供了定量动力学标准。

title: Coarse-graining far-from-equilibrium dynamics using oblique projectors
abstract: We generalize the Mori-Zwanzig projection operator formalism by introducing an oblique projector using biorthogonal variables to coarse-grain the dynamics of systems far from equilibrium, such as active or living matter. Improving on previously used orthogonal projectors, the oblique projector correctly decomposes the emergent interactions of the coarse-grained particles into systematic and stochastic contributions. We show that the formalism directly connects to established results in non-equilibrium linear response theory and adiabatic perturbation theory. Based on this formalism, we develop a coarse-graining algorithm which we apply to extract the emergent non-equilibrium chiral dynamics of a passive tracer in a chiral active bath. Our theory correctly predicts the odd transport properties and a confinement-induced shift of the chiral frequency of the tracer.
summary: 我们通过引入使用双正交变量的倾斜投影仪来粗粒度远离平衡的系统（例如活性或生命物质）的动力学，从而推广了 Mori-Zwanzig 投影算子形式。倾斜投影仪对以前使用的正交投影仪进行了改进，它正确地将粗粒粒子的新兴相互作用分解为系统和随机的贡献。我们表明，该形式直接与非平衡线性响应理论和绝热微扰理论的既定结果相关。基于这种形式，我们开发了一种粗粒度算法，用于提取手性主动浴中被动示踪剂的新兴非平衡手性动力学。我们的理论正确地预测了奇怪的传输特性和限制引起的示踪剂手性频率的变化。

title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
abstract: Weyl semimetals (WSMs), with their unique topological properties and distinct electronic structure, exhibit intriguing properties when either time-reversal or inversion symmetries are broken. In this work, we consider the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction between magnetic impurities in time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSMs. We derive analytical expressions for the full RKKY exchange tensor in arbitrary two-band spinful lattice systems. Our approach reveals both Heisenberg, anisotropic Ising and Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya terms, which can be calculated by energy-integrating real-space Green's functions across the entire Brillouin zone, with the band edge acting as a natural energy cutoff. We apply this framework to study a two-band tight-binding model for a time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSM that interpolates between a Weyl phase with well-separated chiral nodes and a quadratic band-touching semimetal phase. Remarkably, the spatial profile, magnitude, and anisotropic tensor structure of the exchange couplings remain persistent across the node-annihilation transition. This topological robustness reveals that short- and intermediate-range RKKY interactions are mediated by the global, Brillouin-zone-integrated quantum metric of the full valence band rather than being strictly dictated by local low-energy Berry curvature monopoles. These findings demonstrate the necessity of full-band tight-binding formulations when predicting real-space magnetic interactions, providing key insights for electric-field tuning of magnetic anisotropy and constructing realistic models of heavy-fermion and Weyl-Kondo semimetals.
summary:
外尔半金属（WSM）具有独特的拓扑性质和独特的电子结构，当时间反转或反演对称性被打破时，表现出有趣的性质。在这项工作中，我们考虑了时间反转对称性破缺 WSM 中磁性杂质之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 相互作用。我们推导出任意二能带自旋晶格系统中完整 RKKY 交换张量的解析表达式。我们的方法揭示了海森堡项、各向异性伊辛项和 Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya 项，这些项可以通过对整个布里渊区的实空间格林函数进行能量积分来计算，其中带边缘充当自然能量截止。我们应用这个框架来研究时间反演对称性破缺 WSM 的双能带紧束缚模型，该模型在具有良好分离的手性节点的 Weyl 相和二次能带接触半金属相之间进行插值。值得注意的是，交换耦合的空间轮廓、幅度和各向异性张量结构在节点湮灭转变过程中保持不变。

这种拓扑稳健性表明，短程和中程 RKKY 相互作用是由全价带的全局布里渊区积分量子度量介导的，而不是严格由局部低能贝里曲率单极子决定。这些发现证明了在预测真实空间磁相互作用时全带紧束缚公式的必要性，为磁各向异性的电场调谐以及构建重费米子和 Weyl-Kondo 半金属的真实模型提供了关键见解。
