title: Diffusion under competing bulk and surface stopping mechanisms
abstract: We investigate reflected diffusion in a bounded domain subject to two independent, competing stopping mechanisms: an exponentially distributed bulk lifetime of rate $p$ and a surface reaction triggered when the boundary local time exceeds an independent exponential threshold of rate $q$. Denoting by $T$ the stopping time and by $L$ the acquired boundary local time at stopping, we derive their marginal distributions, joint Laplace transform, and complete hierarchy of mixed moments. These statistics are determined by the splitting probability $\phi$ that surface reaction occurs before bulk decay. In particular, we establish the identity $p\expect{T}+q\expect{L}=1$ and show that the cumulative risk $pT+qL$ is exponentially distributed with unit rate. We further obtain equivalent representations of $\phi$ in terms of the Robin-Laplacian and the generalized Steklov spectra. Explicit results for a three-dimensional ball reveal how competing rates $p,q$ control $\phi$ and the $(T,L)$ statistics. Monte Carlo simulations test the universal cumulative-risk law.
summary: 我们研究了有界域中的反射扩散，该机制受到两种独立的、竞争性的停止机制的影响：速率 $p$ 的指数分布整体寿命和当边界局部时间超过速率 $q$ 的独立指数阈值时触发的表面反应。用 $T$ 表示停止时间，用 $L$ 表示停止时获得的边界本地时间，我们推导出它们的边际分布、联合拉普拉斯变换和混合矩的完整层次结构。这些统计数据由表面反应在整体衰变之前发生的分裂概率 $\phi$ 确定。特别是，我们建立恒等式 $p\expect{T}+q\expect{L}=1$ 并表明累积风险 $pT+qL$ 随单位率呈指数分布。我们进一步根据 Robin-Laplacian 和广义 Steklov 谱获得 $\phi$ 的等效表示。三维球的显式结果揭示了竞争率 $p,q$ 如何控制 $\phi$ 和 $(T,L)$ 统计数据。蒙特卡罗模拟测试了普遍的累积风险定律。

title: Connecting heterogeneous dynamics with local entropy
abstract: Establishing a robust and physically interpretable link between static structure and heterogeneous relaxation dynamics remains a fundamental challenge in glass physics. Here, we introduce a weighted pair-entropy descriptor based on the conventional two-body excess entropy. For this, we multiply the integrand used to calculate the excess entropy by a weight function that is directly related to the length scale of the pair correlation function. This multiplication does not affect the contribution of the short range order to the local excess entropy, but allows to take into account the structure present on intermediate distances, i.e., the medium-range order. For a canonical two-dimensional Lennard-Jones glass former, the resulting descriptor exhibits a strong correlation with particle-level dynamical propensity at long times (multiples of the alpha-relaxation time), with a maximum structure--dynamics correlation reaching about 0.9, substantially outperforming the predictive power of the conventional local pair excess entropy. These results demonstrate that incorporating a physically motivated structural length scale into entropy-based descriptors markedly enhances their predictive power while preserving physical interpretability. Our findings provide a simple and general framework for investigating structure--dynamics correlations in glass-forming systems.
summary:
在静态结构和异质弛豫动力学之间建立稳健且物理上可解释的联系仍然是玻璃物理学的基本挑战。在这里，我们引入基于传统二体过剩熵的加权对熵描述符。为此，我们将用于计算过剩熵的被积函数乘以与配对相关函数的长度尺度直接相关的权重函数。这种乘法不会影响短程有序对局部过剩熵的贡献，但允许考虑中间距离上存在的结构，即中程有序。对于规范的二维 Lennard-Jones 玻璃形成体，所得描述符在长时间（α 弛豫时间的倍数）下表现出与粒子级动力学倾向的强相关性，最大结构-动力学相关性达到约 0.9，大大优于传统局部对过剩熵的预测能力。

这些结果表明，将物理驱动的结构长度尺度纳入基于熵的描述符可显着增强其预测能力，同时保留物理可解释性。我们的研究结果为研究玻璃成型系统中的结构-动力学相关性提供了一个简单而通用的框架。

title: Fluctuations of a Photon Bose-Einstein Condensate Coupled to a Reservoir: Describing Coherence Properties in a Free-Energy Model
abstract: Photons are mutually nearly noninteracting particles, so thermalized photon ensembles are commonly obtained not from direct particle-particle-interactions but rather from contact with matter, which can constitute a reservoir for the photon gas. We develop a theory model for photons in a material-filled (e.g. liquid dye) optical microcavity, with the aim to study the fluctuation properties using a free-energy description for noninteracting photons coupled to a reservoir of material electronic excitations. To begin with, we use a single mode description for the condensate. For a small relative size of the material reservoir, corresponding to the canonical regime, condensate number fluctuations are small, and the derived free energy landscape takes the usual Mexican-hat shaped form such that spontaneous symmetry breaking occurs. In contrast, for a large relative size of the reservoir, corresponding to the grand canonical regime, fluctuations become as large as the average particle number. We show that the resulting free energy landscape acquires a bowl-shaped form, with a single minimum at the origin. Thus, a macroscopic occupation of the ground state (i.e., Bose-Einstein condensation) in the absence of spontaneous symmetry breaking is expected. We also provide a model for the treatment of a photon gas trapped in a box-shaped potential with spatially distributed coupling to a reservoir. The model predicts, for example, a statistically fluctuating pattern of islands with long-range coherence, resembling transient microcondensates.
summary:
光子是相互几乎不相互作用的粒子，因此热化光子系综通常不是通过直接的粒子间相互作用获得的，而是通过与物质的接触获得的，物质可以构成光子气体的储存库。我们开发了填充材料（例如液体染料）光学微腔中光子的理论模型，目的是使用耦合到材料电子激发储库的非相互作用光子的自由能描述来研究涨落特性。首先，我们对冷凝物使用单一模式描述。对于相对尺寸较小的物质库，对应于正则体系，凝聚态数波动较小，并且导出的自由能景观采用通常的墨西哥帽形状的形式，从而发生自发对称性破缺。相反，对于与大正则体系相对应的相对较大的储库尺寸，波动变得与平均粒子数一样大。我们表明，由此产生的自由能景观获得碗形形状，在原点处具有单个最小值。

因此，在没有自发对称性破缺的情况下，预计会出现宏观占据基态（即玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。我们还提供了一个模型，用于处理被困在箱形势中的光子气体，该箱形势与储层空间分布耦合。例如，该模型预测具有长程相干性的岛屿的统计波动模式，类似于瞬态微凝结物。

title: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
abstract: The confluence of strong electronic correlations and Berry curvature-driven transport constitutes a largely underexplored frontier in quantum materials research, particularly in systems where electronic correlations arise from flat-band physics rather than conventional $f$-electron states. Here, we report an intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport in the dilute Kondo system Ru$_2$Mn$_{0.5}$Ti$_{0.5}$Ge, a non-$f$-electron Heusler alloy hosting flat bands with van Hove singularity proximate to the Fermi level. The anomalous Hall response is strikingly non-monotonic, violating the Fermi-liquid scaling relation near the magnetic transition and is restored only at low temperature, coincident with the onset of Kondo coherence. \textit{Ab initio} calculations strongly establish that the Berry curvature originates from the Kondo hybridization induced interplay of flat bands and spin-orbit coupling mediated anticrossings at the Fermi level. Our findings demonstrate that Kondo coherence of flat bands bears a profound impact on Berry curvature associated ferroic responses, mandating a rigorous theoretical understanding of anomalous transport in the regime where reciprocal space topology and strong correlations are intrinsically intertwined.
summary:
强电子相关性和贝里曲率驱动的输运的融合构成了量子材料研究中很大程度上尚未开发的前沿领域，特别是在电子相关性来自平带物理而不是传统的 $f$ 电子态的系统中。在这里，我们报告了稀近藤系统 Ru$_2$Mn$_{0.5}$Ti$_{0.5}$Ge 中固有的贝里曲率驱动的反常霍尔传输，这是一种非 $f$ 电子赫斯勒合金，其平带具有接近费米能级的范霍夫奇点。反常霍尔响应是惊人的非单调性，违反了磁转变附近的费米-液体标度关系，并且仅在低温下恢复，这与近藤相干性的开始一致。 \textit{Ab initio}计算有力地证明，贝里曲率源于近藤杂化引起的平带和自旋轨道耦合介导的费米能级反交叉的相互作用。

我们的研究结果表明，平带的近藤相干性对贝里曲率相关的铁响应具有深远的影响，要求对相互空间拓扑和强相关性本质上交织在一起的体系中的异常输运进行严格的理论理解。

title: How dipolar interactions structure molecular droplets
abstract: We investigate how dipolar interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules structure the self-bound droplets formed under variation of the interaction strength. We identify the transition from droplets to crystals as a finite-size first order transition. With droplet-ring states and transitional supersolid states we predict additional structure in the crystal and droplet phases, respectively. To describe this strongly correlated regime, and in particular the reconfiguration of quantum ground states, we design a variational Monte Carlo framework based on neural quantum states. It is especially suitable to describe ground states and almost degenerate states with very different configurations. Moreover, one can easily determine the superfluid fraction. Our results reveal the sequence of finite-size structures through which dipolar interactions reorganize molecular droplets into crystals.
summary: 我们研究了微波屏蔽极性分子之间的偶极相互作用如何构造在相互作用强度变化下形成的自结合液滴。我们将从液滴到晶体的转变视为有限尺寸的一阶转变。通过液滴环态和过渡超固态，我们分别预测晶体相和液滴相中的附加结构。为了描述这种强相关的状态，特别是量子基态的重新配置，我们设计了一个基于神经量子态的变分蒙特卡罗框架。它特别适合描述构型截然不同的基态和近简并态。此外，人们可以很容易地确定超流体分数。我们的结果揭示了有限尺寸结构的序列，通过偶极相互作用将分子液滴重组为晶体。

title: Molecular interfacial rheology: Lipid membrane shear viscosity
abstract: We develop a method to extract the shear viscosity of a lipid membrane from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. The method characterizes the rheology of general interfacial systems embedded in three-dimensional media; we term it molecular interfacial rheology. In our simulations the planar bilayer and surrounding water are confined between solid, parallel walls. Following Onsager's regression hypothesis, membrane and water fluctuations are assumed to relax according to the coupled continuum-mechanical equations governing the confined system---which predict that the membrane transverse velocity autocorrelation function (TVACF) decays exponentially, at a rate set by the membrane and water viscosities. The measured TVACF, however, exhibits damped oscillations followed by a slowly decaying tail. We reconcile these behaviors using the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, and extract the wavevector-dependent membrane viscosity from the time-integral of the TVACF. Results from theory and simulations agree over a decade of wavevectors, and extrapolating to long wavelengths yields shear viscosities ranging from 0.064 to 0.18 pN*us/nm across two representative single-component, fluid-phase bilayers. Our results are corroborated by nonequilibrium simulations where a spatially varying in-plane body force is applied to lipid molecules, thus validating the framework of molecular interfacial rheology.
summary:
我们开发了一种从平衡分子动力学模拟中提取脂质膜剪切粘度的方法。该方法表征了嵌入三维介质中的一般界面系统的流变性；我们称之为分子界面流变学。在我们的模拟中，平面双层和周围的水被限制在坚固的平行壁之间。根据 Onsager 的回归假设，假设膜和水的波动根据控制约束系统的耦合连续力学方程松弛，该方程预测膜横向速度自相关函数 (TVACF) 以膜和水粘度设定的速率呈指数衰减。然而，测量的 TVACF 表现出阻尼振荡，随后出现缓慢衰减的尾部。我们使用 Mori--Zwanzig 形式协调这些行为，并从 TVACF 的时间积分中提取与波矢量相关的膜粘度。

理论和模拟的结果与十多年的波矢一致，并且外推到长波长，在两个代表性的单组分流体双层中产生的剪切粘度范围为 0.064 至 0.18 pN*us/nm。我们的结果得到了非平衡模拟的证实，其中空间变化的平面内力应用于脂质分子，从而验证了分子界面流变学的框架。

title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
abstract: Non-reciprocal interactions are ubiquitous in active, biological, and disordered systems, generically driving them out of equilibrium. Here, we introduce a hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models governed by a tunable non-reciprocity parameter $g$. At a special point $g=g^*$, the drift matrix becomes non-diagonalizable, realizing exceptional points (EP's) of different orders, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors simultaneously coalesce. The hierarchy encompasses non-reciprocally coupled dimers, their disordered counterparts, and a many-body chain exactly mapping onto the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model in the arena of non-Hermitian quantum systems. For the disordered model, we show that the distribution of the EP location $g^*$ across disorder realizations develops a universal edge singularity precisely at the clean-system EP, and is manifestly non-self-averaging. Across all models, we find that at the EP, the usual exponential relaxation of the autocorrelation and covariance functions is dressed by a polynomial-in-time prefactor whose degree is set by the order of the EP and whose detailed structure encodes the spatial architecture of the chain. At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits ``pseudo-equilibrium'': its steady-state distribution factorizes into equilibrium-like single-particle measures despite a nonzero steady-state current. Moreover, the $N$-particle interacting system decomposes into $N/2$ independent complex OU processes. Finally, using the Harada-Sasa relation, we obtain a closed-form expression for the total steady-state heat dissipation and uncover a boundary refrigeration effect, in which the boundary particles switch from acting as a hot to a cold reservoir as the non-reciprocity is tuned.
summary:
非互惠相互作用在活跃的生物系统和无序系统中普遍存在，通常会使它们失去平衡。在这里，我们引入了由可调非互易参数 $g$ 控制的非互易交互 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) 模型的层次结构。在特殊点 $g=g^*$ 处，漂移矩阵变得不可对角化，从而实现不同阶的异常点 (EP)，其中特征值和特征向量同时合并。该层次结构包含非互易耦合的二聚体、它们的无序对应物，以及精确映射到非厄米量子系统领域中典型的 Hatano-Nelson 模型的多体链。对于无序模型，我们证明了 EP 位置 $g^*$ 在无序实现中的分布精确地在干净系统 EP 处形成了通用边缘奇点，并且显然是非自平均的。在所有模型中，我们发现在 EP 处，自相关和协方差函数的通常指数松弛由时间多项式前置因子修饰，其次数由 EP 的阶数设置，其详细结构编码链的空间架构。

在完全不对称的情况下，多体链表现出“伪平衡”：尽管稳态电流非零，但其稳态分布分解为类似平衡的单粒子测量。此外，$N$个粒子相互作用系统分解为$N/2$个独立的复杂OU过程。最后，利用 Harada-Sasa 关系，我们获得了总稳态散热的封闭式表达式，并揭示了边界制冷效应，其中随着非互易性的调整，边界粒子从热库转变为冷库。

title: Eye-opening bounds on cusps
abstract: We derive new nonperturbative inequalities on the cusp anomalous dimensions of conformal line defects. We impose reflection positivity, locality, and conformal invariance on a pair of cusps forming an ``eye'' geometry, deriving a novel condition on the cusp anomalous dimension which we refer to as conformal concavity. The resulting constraint is much stronger than the known angular concavity, and our derivation applies also to cusps involving distinct line defects. Remarkably, it directly links the smooth and fusion limits, yielding bounds on defect-changing operator dimensions, Casimir energies, and subleading fusion data. We thus uncover a new quantitative bridge between aspects of the local operator data and the fusion rules of line operators in conformal field theories.
summary: 我们推导出关于共形线缺陷的尖点异常尺寸的新的非微扰不等式。我们将反射正性、局部性和共形不变性强加在一对形成“眼睛”几何形状的尖点上，得出尖点异常维度的新颖条件，我们将其称为共形凹性。由此产生的约束比已知的角凹度强得多，并且我们的推导也适用于涉及不同线缺陷的尖点。值得注意的是，它直接连接平滑和融合极限，产生缺陷改变算子维度、卡西米尔能量和次领先融合数据的界限。因此，我们揭示了局部算子数据方面与共形场论中线算子的融合规则之间的新的定量桥梁。

title: Boundary-Boundary Duality on Regular Black Holes, Supersymmetric Solitons and Holographic Spinning Plasma Disks
abstract: We construct a new family of exact rotating solutions of four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory with negative cosmological constant describing regular spinning AdS black holes and smooth solitons. The geometries are free of curvature singularities and admit open regions of parameter space without closed timelike curves, while supersymmetric limits correspond to causally regular horizonless configurations. A remarkable feature of these solutions is the existence of at least two codimension-one conformal boundaries. The first is Minkowski spacetime, where the expectation value of the energy--momentum tensor describes a finite spinning disk of strongly coupled conformal plasma whose edge rotates at the speed of light. The second boundary is a rotating black-hole geometry with vanishing energy--momentum tensor but non-vanishing Cotton tensor, defining a holographic theory in which the dual graviton is fixed at the boundary. We show that the energy density associated with the dual graviton exactly reproduces that of the plasma after a suitable analytic continuation and the identification of the holographic energy scale with the Lorentz factor of the rotating fluid, providing evidence for a boundary-boundary duality. Indeed, electromagnetic duality exchanges the electric and magnetic currents between the boundary supporting the graviton and that supporting the dual graviton thus providing a generalized mirror symmetry between these boundary theories. Hence, the Lorentz factor is identified with the electromagnetic dual of the renormalization scale. In an appropriate limit, the solutions reduce to the planar Reissner--Nordström--AdS black hole, whereas the supersymmetric solitons have no regular static limit.
summary:
我们构造了一个新的四维爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦理论的精确旋转解族，其负宇宙常数描述了规则旋转的 AdS 黑洞和光滑孤子。这些几何形状没有曲率奇点，并且允许参数空间的开放区域，而没有闭合的类时曲线，而超对称极限对应于因果规则的无水平配置。这些解决方案的一个显着特征是存在至少两个余维一共形边界。第一个是闵可夫斯基时空，其中能量动量张量的期望值描述了强耦合共形等离子体的有限旋转盘，其边缘以光速旋转。第二个边界是具有消失能量的旋转黑洞几何——动量张量但非消失的科顿张量，定义了双引力子固定在边界处的全息理论。

我们证明，在适当的解析延拓以及用旋转流体的洛伦兹因子识别全息能量尺度后，与双引力子相关的能量密度精确地再现了等离子体的能量密度，为边界-边界二元性提供了证据。事实上，电磁对偶性在支持引力子的边界和支持对偶引力子的边界之间交换电流和磁流，从而在这些边界理论之间提供了广义的镜像对称性。因此，洛伦兹因子等同于重整化尺度的电磁对偶。在适当的极限下，解简化为平面 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 黑洞，而超对称孤子则没有规则的静态极限。

title: Superselected ghost theory: entangled pairs
abstract: The superselection-rule approach to ghost theories is extended to theories with a nonreal spectrum containing a complex-conjugate pair of poles on the physical sheet. The two excitations are labeled by their respective complex masses, $M$ and $M^*$, and the superselection sectors are labeled by $n$, the difference between the numbers of $M$ and $M^*$ excitations. The corresponding generalized ghost parity $Q$ assigns a phase $e^{in\alpha}$ to each sector. Under $Q$ superselection, nonvanishing norms occur only in the $n=0$ sector, and the physical state condition $Q^{2}|s\rangle=|s\rangle$ projects onto this sector. For a $MM^*$ pair carrying real total energy and momentum, we define a swap operation $R$. The $R$-eigenstates are entangled pairs, and an $R$ superselection rule ensures positive probabilities. We discuss how the optical theorem describes physical cuts through these entangled pairs.
summary: 鬼理论的超选择规则方法被扩展到具有非实谱的理论，该非实谱包含物理片上的复共轭极点对。两个激励由它们各自的复质量 $M$ 和 $M^*$ 标记，超选择扇区由 $n$ 标记，即 $M$ 和 $M^*$ 激励数量之间的差值。相应的广义幽灵奇偶校验$Q$为每个扇区分配一个相位$e^{in\alpha}$。在 $Q$ 超选择下，非零范数仅出现在 $n=0$ 扇区中，并且物理状态条件 $Q^{2}|s\rangle=|s\rangle$ 投射到该扇区。对于携带实际总能量和动量的 $MM^*$ 对，我们定义交换操作 $R$。 $R$ 本征态是纠缠对，$R$ 超选择规则可确保正概率。我们讨论光学定理如何描述这些纠缠对的物理切割。

title: UV/IR scale dependence in a four-derivative scalar field theory
abstract: An analog of the standard renormalization procedure may be useful for four-derivative theories, and we illustrate it with the four-derivative scalar field theory in the $m\to0$ limit. The renormalization scale $\mu$ appears in momentum-dependent logarithms associated with both UV and IR divergences. At one loop, the on-shell scattering amplitude satisfies an analog Callan--Symanzik equation involving the analog beta functions. These functions are determined from the combined UV and IR pole parts of the 1PI functions.
summary: 标准重正化过程的模拟可能对四导数理论有用，我们用 $m\to0$ 极限中的四导数标量场理论来说明它。重正化尺度 $\mu$ 出现在与 UV 和 IR 散度相关的动量相关对数中。在一个循环中，壳上散射幅度满足涉及模拟 beta 函数的模拟 Callan-Symanzik 方程。这些函数由 1PI 函数的 UV 和 IR 极点部分的组合确定。

title: Higher-Dimensional Integrable Scattering
abstract: This paper describes classical soliton scattering in the 2+1d integrable chiral model, related to the Bogomolny monopole equation and self-dual Yang-Mills, as a case study for higher-dimensional integrable scattering. Extended line solitons exhibit nontrivial scattering with lump solitons and with other line solitons, and $N \to N$ interactions can be factorised into a series of $2 \to 2$ interactions. Scattering between parallel line solitons in 3d is related to lump soliton scattering in 2d, allowing for direct comparison with results in 1+1d integrable field theories.
summary: 本文描述了 2+1d 可积手性模型中的经典孤子散射，与 Bogomolny 单极方程和自对偶 Yang-Mills 相关，作为高维可积散射的案例研究。延长线孤子与块孤子和其他线孤子表现出非平凡的散射，并且 $N \to N$ 相互作用可以分解为一系列 $2 \to 2$ 相互作用。 3d 中平行线孤子之间的散射与 2d 中集总孤子散射相关，因此可以与 1+1d 可积场论中的结果进行直接比较。

title: On Quasiparticles within the Refined Gribov-Zwanziger Model
abstract: The problem of the effective excitations of a gauge theory in the nonperturbative regime remains not completely understood. Using the Refined Gribov-Zwanziger (RGZ) theory as effective model for pure gauge Yang-Mills theories, we revisit the quasiparticle (quadratic) excitations of the theory. A novel interpretation of such quasiparticles is proposed, in the case of real mass poles, taking into account the manifest ${\cal PT}-$symmetry of the RGZ Lagrangian.
summary: 非微扰状态下规范理论的有效激励问题仍未完全被理解。使用精炼的 Gribov-Zwanziger (RGZ) 理论作为纯规范杨-米尔斯理论的有效模型，我们重新审视该理论的准粒子（二次）激励。在实质量极点的情况下，考虑到 RGZ 拉格朗日量的明显 ${\cal PT}-$ 对称性，提出了对此类准粒子的新颖解释。

title: Open-Closed-Open Triality for 1/2 BPS Three-Point Functions
abstract: Open-closed-open triality relates two distinct open string descriptions through a common closed string theory. In this paper, we develop an open-closed-open triality for protected half-BPS three-point functions in four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory. Starting from determinant insertions representing giant gravitons, we formulate a V-type open-string Gaussian three-matrix model and, through a color-flavor transformation, derive an F-type open-string model of three bifundamental matrices forming a triangular quiver. Its closed quiver walks include oriented cubic cycles, a feature absent from the bipartite two-point case. We test the correspondence by deriving exact finite-$N$ single-giant polynomials, recovering the known F-type large-$N$ saddles, and proving the equivalence of the V- and F-type character expansions via an explicit bijection of their combinatorial data. At the closed string corner, connected three-matrix contractions determine three-colored integer Strebel surfaces. We argue that the corresponding target-space construction is naturally described by a barycentrically subdivided Belyi map or a colored Hurwitz constellation.
summary: 开-闭-开三性通过共同的闭弦理论将两个不同的开弦描述联系起来。在本文中，我们在四维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills 理论中开发了受保护的半 BPS 三点函数的开-闭-开试验。从代表巨引力子的行列式插入开始，我们制定了V型开弦高斯三矩阵模型，并通过颜色风味变换推导出形成三角形箭袋的三个双基本矩阵的F型开弦模型。它的封闭箭袋行走包括定向立方循环，这是二分两点情况所没有的特征。我们通过推导精确的有限$N$单巨多项式、恢复已知的F型大$N$鞍点以及通过组合数据的显式双射证明V型和F型字符展开的等价性来测试对应关系。在闭合弦角处，连接的三矩阵收缩确定三色整数斯特雷贝尔曲面。我们认为，相应的目标空间结构自然可以通过重心细分的 Belyi 地图或彩色 Hurwitz 星座来描述。

title: Hironaka Geometry and Resurgence in Finite-$N$ Matrix Models
abstract: We study how finite-$N$ invariant theory organizes the non-perturbative structure of matrix models. For a model of four traceless Hermitian $2\times 2$ matrices, the Hironaka decomposition realizes the gauge-invariant configuration space as an eight-sheeted branched cover of the space of primary invariants. We show that ramification points of this cover naturally generate additional saddle points when the action depends only on the primaries. For an explicit rank-two saddle, we compute its action, one-loop normalization and Picard--Lefschetz connection to the perturbative vacuum. The same saddle controls the leading Borel singularity and large-order growth of perturbation theory, while its first fluctuation correction reproduces the first subleading large-order correction with no fitted parameters. Our results provide a concrete link between finite-$N$ invariant geometry and resurgence in matrix models.
summary: 我们研究有限-$N$ 不变理论如何组织矩阵模型的非微扰结构。对于四个无迹 Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵的模型，Hironaka 分解将规范不变配置空间实现为主不变量空间的八片分支覆盖。我们表明，当作用仅取决于原色时，该覆盖层的分支点自然会生成额外的鞍点。对于显式二阶鞍座，我们计算其作用、单循环归一化以及与微扰真空的 Picard--Lefschetz 连接。相同的鞍点控制着微扰理论的主导Borel奇点和大阶增长，而它的第一次涨落校正再现了没有拟合参数的第一次次主导大阶校正。我们的结果提供了有限$N$不变几何与矩阵模型复兴之间的具体联系。

title: Form Factor Alphabets and Antipodal Duality from Cluster Algebras
abstract: We develop a cluster-algebraic description of symbol alphabets for chiral stress-tensor form factors in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory. Motivated by unfolding the three-point $C_2$ quiver, we propose a periodic framework for $n$-point form-factor alphabets based on folding a $\mathrm{Gr}(4,2n)$ quiver with two periods of frozen nodes. At four points, the folding leads to the $\widetilde{\mathrm{VI}}$ cluster algebra, which has infinitely many cluster variables. Tropical truncation selects a finite set of rational coordinates and four physical limit rays. The $A_1^{(1)}$ mutation sequences approaching these rays generate the four square roots and the corresponding algebraic-letter spaces. Within the resulting finite set of rational candidates, antipodal closure excludes precisely eight additional letters. On the parity-preserving surface, the antipodal map is realized, after a further folding, by two commuting mutations followed by a relabelling. Furthermore, we find an alternative quiver within the same mutation class that becomes self-antipodal after parity folding, mirroring the antipodal self-duality of the four-point MHV form factor. Its double- and triple-collinear boundaries reproduce, respectively, the $C_2$ algebra of the three-point form factor and the $A_3$ algebra of the six-point amplitude; after folding the latter to $C_2$, the antipodal map exchanges the two $C_2$ boundaries.
summary:
我们在平面 $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills 理论中开发了手征应力张量形状因子的符号字母表的簇代数描述。通过展开三点 $C_2$ 箭袋，我们提出了一个基于 $\mathrm{Gr}(4,2n)$ 箭袋与两个周期冻结节点折叠的 $n$ 点形状因子字母表的周期框架。在四个点处，折叠得到 $\widetilde{\mathrm{VI}}$ 簇代数，它具有无限多个簇变量。热带截断选择一组有限的有理坐标和四个物理极限射线。接近这些射线的 $A_1​​^{(1)}$ 突变序列生成四个平方根和相应的代数字母空间。在由此产生的有限理性候选集中，对映封闭精确地排除了八个额外的字母。在保留奇偶性的表面上，在进一步折叠之后，通过两个交换突变和随后的重新标记来实现对映图。此外，我们发现同一突变类别中的另一种颤动在奇偶折叠后变得自对足，反映了四点 MHV 形状因子的对足自对偶性。

其双共线和三重共线边界分别再现三点形状因子的$C_2$代数和六点振幅的$A_3$代数；将后者折叠到 $C_2$ 后，对映图交换两个 $C_2$ 边界。

title: What is Classical Null String Theory?
abstract: We revisit the classical definition of a null string in a D-dimensional Minkowski target space and distinguish a consistent partially-gauged Carrollian sigma-model from the null string theory. The Isberg-Lindström-Sundborg-Theodoridis (ILST) action gauges worldsheet diffeomorphisms and the common Weyl rescaling, but not the independent relative rescaling of the temporal and spatial representatives of the intrinsic Carrollian structure, Carroll-Weyl scaling. A physical string theory requires every local change of worldsheet representative to be gauged, therefore, the Carroll-Weyl symmetry should be gauged in a null string theory. In the minimal realization, the corresponding gauging is obstructed at finite tension, whereas at zero tension it yields an additional first-class constraint and the associated identification of physical configurations along its gauge orbits. The description of the null worldsheet as a congruence of null geodesics provides a complementary target-space interpretation of gauging of the Carroll-Weyl scaling. Our analysis thus provides the supplementary requirements that turns the ILST theory into the null string theory.
summary: 我们重新审视 D 维 Minkowski 目标空间中空弦的经典定义，并将一致的部分测量卡罗尔 sigma 模型与空弦理论区分开来。 Isberg-Lindström-Sundborg-Theodoridis (ILST) 作用衡量世界表微分同胚和常见的 Weyl 重新标度，但不是内在卡罗尔结构的时间和空间代表的独立相对重新标度，即 Carroll-Weyl 标度。物理弦理论需要测量世界表代表的每一个局部变化，因此，卡罗尔-韦尔对称性应该在零弦理论中测量。在最小实现中，相应的测量在有限张力下受到阻碍，而在零张力下，它产生额外的一流约束以及沿其规范轨道的物理配置的相关识别。将零世界表描述为零测地线的同余，为卡罗尔-韦尔标度的测量提供了补充的目标空间解释。因此，我们的分析提供了将 ILST 理论转变为空弦理论的补充要求。

title: de Sitter and S-folds in type IIB from $\mathcal{N} = 4$ $D = 4$ gauged supergravity
abstract: In this paper, we classify the type IIB uplifts of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ $D=4$ pure $\text{SO}(4)$-gauged supergravity admitting a dS$_4$ solution. As for their AdS cousins, the internal geometries of these uplifts consist of two $S^2$ fibred over a Riemann surface $\Sigma$, and are classified by pairs of harmonic functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma$, providing a new family of de Sitter solutions in type IIB. Choosing specific functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma = \mathbb{R} \times I$, we perform an S-fold quotient of the internal space along its non-compact direction. This S-folding allows us to evade the assumptions of the Maldacena-Nunez no-go theorem and provides a classical de Sitter solution of type IIB supergravity with finite and non-vanishing four-dimensional effective Newton constant.
summary: 在本文中，我们对 $\mathcal{N}=4$ $D=4$ 纯 $\text{SO}(4)$ 计量超重力的 IIB 型隆起进行分类，承认 dS$_4$ 解。至于它们的 AdS 表亲，这些隆起的内部几何结构由黎曼表面 $\Sigma$ 上的两个 $S^2$ 纤维组成，并按 $\Sigma$ 上的调和函数对 $h_{1,\,2}$ 进行分类，提供了 IIB 型新系列德西特解。在 $\Sigma = \mathbb{R} \times I$ 上选择特定函数 $h_{1,\,2}$，我们沿内部空间的非紧方向执行 S 折商。这种 S 折叠使我们能够避开 Maldacena-Nunez no-go 定理的假设，并提供具有有限且非零的四维有效牛顿常数的 IIB 型超引力的经典德西特解。

title: The endless journey towards the horizon of a quantum black hole
abstract: It is a problem of great importance in quantum gravity whether quantum effects lead to nontrivial structure near black hole horizons, and if their interiors are emergent features of a large $N$ limit. We show that the strongly chaotic nature of black holes, captured by random matrix statistics of their spectrum, makes it so that a suitably gravitationally dressed infalling observer takes an infinite amount of proper time to reach the horizon. This makes the black hole interior operationally inaccessible to any outside observer, marking a sharp breakdown of the large $N$ causal structure of black holes in quantum gravity. To model the experience of an infalling observer, we study the response of an infalling particle detector coupled to a matter field in a 2d quantum black hole background, finding a peak in the detector's excitation probability as it enters an infinitely long non-perturbative journey close to the black hole horizon.
summary: 量子效应是否导致黑洞视界附近的非平凡结构，以及它们的内部是否是大$N$极限的涌现特征，是量子引力中一个非常重要的问题。我们证明了黑洞的强烈混沌性质，通过其光谱的随机矩阵统计来捕获，使得一个经过适当引力处理的坠落观察者需要无限长的适当时间才能到达地平线。这使得任何外部观察者都无法进入黑洞内部，标志着量子引力中黑洞的大$N$因果结构的急剧崩溃。为了模拟坠落观察者的体验，我们研究了坠落粒子探测器与二维量子黑洞背景中的物质场耦合的响应，当探测器进入接近黑洞视界的无限长非微扰旅程时，发现探测器激发概率的峰值。

title: CFT characters from localization
abstract: We explain a general procedure to compute characters of chiral algebras of 2d (S)CFTs geometrically from their coadjoint orbits, in analogy with the coadjoint orbit method for finite-dimensional Lie groups. We demonstrate that this method can be used to give concise rederivations of the characters of the Virasoro algebra, Kac-Moody algebras, as well as supersymmetric generalizations.
summary: 我们解释了从几何上计算 2d (S)CFT 手性代数特征的一般过程，类似于有限维李群的共伴轨道方法。我们证明该方法可用于给出 Virasoro 代数、Kac-Moody 代数以及超对称推广的特征的简明重新推导。

title: Infrared Memory and Scrambling in a Dynamically Opened Coupled-SYK Majorana Junction
abstract: We study a dynamically opened Majorana junction formed by two coupled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) systems. A time-dependent bilinear coupling drives the system from a nearly decoupled to a strongly hybridized regime, providing an interacting realization of a Majorana shutter. Using a low-frequency analysis of the large-$N$ Keldysh theory around the conformal $q=4$ SYK saddle, we find that the opening retains a strong infrared memory, with the associated anomalous response becoming increasingly sensitive to the infrared cutoff. Exact finite-dimensional simulations of two $N=8$ SYK clusters show enhanced inter-sector entanglement, parity transfer, and cross-sector operator scrambling after the opening. These results connect the infrared structure of conformal SYK dynamics with finite-size many-body scrambling and show how a dynamically opened interacting Majorana system can retain long-wavelength memory beyond the quadratic limit.
summary: 我们研究了由两个耦合的 Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) 系统形成的动态开放的马约拉纳结。时间相关的双线性耦合将系统从近解耦状态驱动到强混合状态，从而提供了马约拉纳快门的交互实现。通过对共形 $q=4$ SYK 鞍座周围的大 $N$ Keldysh 理论进行低频分析，我们发现开口保留了强大的红外记忆，相关的异常响应对红外截止变得越来越敏感。两个 $N=8$ SYK 集群的精确有限维模拟显示，开放后扇区间纠缠、奇偶校验转移和跨扇区算子扰乱增强。这些结果将共形 SYK 动力学的红外结构与有限尺寸多体置乱联系起来，并展示了动态开放的交互马约拉纳系统如何能够保留超出二次极限的长波长记忆。

title: Decompactification and the Flat-Space Limit of AdS$_5\times$ S$^5$ Master Correlators
abstract: We study the flat-space limit of AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ holographic correlators while accounting for the simultaneous decompactification of the internal S$^5$. We show that this limit is naturally formulated in terms of master propagators and correlators, which resum the infinite tower of Kaluza--Klein modes. For boundary correlators, the resulting expressions can be interpreted in terms of amplitudes with kinematics restricted to 5d. We then consider master correlators whose external insertions are kept in the AdS$_5\times$S$^5$ bulk before taking the limit, and argue that they recover flat-space amplitudes with unrestricted kinematics in 10d Minkowski space. Finally, we show that the flat-space limit commutes with the boundary limit if we analytically continue the sphere so that the bulk geometry becomes AdS$_5 \times$dS$_5$, and the resulting formulae suggest an interpretation in terms of amplitudes in flat space with two time directions and with 10d kinematics satisfying two simultaneous null constraints. We discuss the implications of these constructions for flat-space holography and its relation to the Carrollian limit of the dual CFT.
summary: 我们研究 AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ 全息相关器的平坦空间限制，同时考虑内部 S$^5$ 的同时解紧。我们证明了这个极限是自然地用主传播器和相关器来表述的，它们恢复了卡鲁扎的无限塔——克莱因模式。对于边界相关器，结果表达式可以用运动学限制为 5d 的幅度来解释。然后，我们考虑主相关器，其外部插入在取极限之前保留在 AdS$_5\times$S$^5$ 块中，并认为它们在 10d Minkowski 空间中以不受限制的运动学恢复平坦空间振幅。最后，我们表明，如果我们分析地继续球体，使整体几何形状变为 AdS$_5 \times$dS$_5$，则平坦空间极限与边界极限相通，并且所得公式建议根据具有两个时间方向和满足两个同时零约束的 10d 运动学的平坦空间中的振幅进行解释。我们讨论这些结构对平面空间全息术的影响及其与对偶 CFT 卡罗尔极限的关系。

title: Derived Associative Algebras and Cyclic Cohomology of Q-manifolds
abstract: Loday's derived product is revisited in the setting of Q-manifolds, i.e., supermanifolds equipped with an odd vector field that `squares to zero'. We interpret the Grassmann odd product as a standard product upon shifting the grading, which implies the existence of a derived (noncommutative) associative $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded algebra associated with any Q-manifold. We apply Connes' cyclic cohomology to the derived associative algebra, giving a new cohomology on Q-manifolds distinct from the standard cohomology: we refer to this as the derived cyclic cohomology of a Q-manifold. The derived cyclic cocycles are interpreted as classically BRST-invariant functionals within the BV--BFV--BRST formalism or generalised Ruelle--Sullivan currents when applied to regular foliations via their foliation Lie algebroids.
summary: 在 Q 流形的设置中重新审视洛迪的导出积，即配备有“平方为零”的奇向量场的超流形。我们将格拉斯曼奇积解释为转移分级时的标准积，这意味着存在与任何 Q 流形相关的派生（非交换）关联 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 分级代数。我们将 Connes 的循环上同调应用于导出的结合代数，给出了与标准上同调不同的 Q 流形上的新上同调：我们将其称为 Q 流形的导出循环上同调。当通过其叶状李代数体应用于规则叶状结构时，导出的循环余循环被解释为 BV--BFV--BRST 形式主义或广义 Ruelle--Sullivan 流中的经典 BRST 不变泛函。

title: Finite-Corner Reconstruction and Separation for Cones of Normal Maps
abstract: We develop a finite-corner framework for convex cones of normal maps between \(\mathcal B(\mathcal H)\) and \(\mathcal B(\mathcal K)\). The basic structural assumption is stability under finite cut--pad operations. We prove that every point-ultraweakly closed cut--pad stable cone is completely determined by its finite-dimensional corner cones, and conversely that every coherent family of closed finite-dimensional corner cones admits a unique global realization of this type. For a cut--pad stable cone that is not necessarily point-ultraweakly closed, reconstruction from the norm closures of its corner cones yields exactly its point-ultraweak closure. Combining this reconstruction principle with finite-dimensional separation and the Choi representation, we show that non-membership in a global cone is always detected on a single finite-dimensional corner by a finite-dimensional witness. We illustrate the framework for completely positive and decomposable maps; in the decomposable case, the Hermitian parts of the finite-corner witnesses are PPT.
summary: 我们为 \(\mathcal B(\mathcal H)\) 和 \(\mathcal B(\mathcal K)\) 之间法线贴图的凸锥体开发了一个有限角框架。基本的结构假设是有限切割-垫操作下的稳定性。我们证明了每个点超弱闭切垫稳定锥完全由其有限维角锥决定，相反，每个相关的闭有限维角锥族都承认这种类型的唯一全局实现。对于不一定是点超弱闭合的切垫稳定锥，从其角锥的范数闭包重建精确地产生其点超弱闭合。将这种重建原理与有限维分离和 Choi 表示相结合，我们表明，有限维见证人总是在单个有限维角上检测到全局锥体中的非隶属关系。我们阐释了完全正向且可分解的地图的框架；在可分解的情况下，有限角见证人的埃尔米特部分是 PPT。

title: Representation Theory of Canonical Commutation Relations Arising from the Quantization of the Klein-Gordon Equation with an External Potential
abstract: We investigate the Weyl representation of the canonical commutation relations for a model describing a quantized massive scalar field under the influence of an external potential. The main problem is to determine whether the Weyl representation remains equivalent to or becomes inequivalent to the original one when the mass and/or potential are changed. This problem is reduced to the study of Schrödinger operators. It turns out that the Weyl representations are inequivalent when the masses differ. Moreover, when the masses are the same, the transition between equivalence and inequivalence occurs at the decay rate $-3/2$ of the difference between the potentials. This contrasts with the decay rate $-1$ that defines the short-range condition in scattering theory.
summary: 我们研究了描述外部势影响下的量化大标量场的模型的规范交换关系的 Weyl 表示。主要问题是确定当质量和/或势改变时，Weyl 表示是否仍然等于或变得不等于原始表示。这个问题归结为薛定谔算子的研究。事实证明，当群众不同时，韦尔表示是不等价的。此外，当质量相同时，等价和不等价之间的转变发生在电位差的衰减率 $-3/2$ 处。这与定义散射理论中短程条件的衰减率 $-1$ 形成鲜明对比。

title: Reply to the Comment on "The Axiom of Choice and the No-Signalling Principle"
abstract: We clarify the meaning of a probabilistic no-signalling strategy in Ref [Proc. R. Soc. A 481, 20240601]. For every fixed input, the deterministic strategy constructed using the Axiom of Choice can indeed be represented by a Dirac probability distribution over the outputs. The relevant distinction arises when one considers the complete process from input to output, with the input itself sampled according to a probability distribution. In this case, the input and output spaces must be measurable and the dependence of the conditional output distribution on the input must also be measurable. Equivalently, the conditional distributions must form a Markov kernel. The Axiom-of-Choice strategy fails precisely this measurability requirement.
summary: 我们在参考文献[Proc.1]中阐明了概率无信号策略的含义。 R.苏克。 A 481, 20240601]。对于每个固定输入，使用选择公理构建的确定性策略确实可以用输出上的狄拉克概率分布来表示。当人们考虑从输入到输出的完整过程时，就会出现相关的区别，并且输入本身根据概率分布进行采样。在这种情况下，输入和输出空间必须是可测量的，并且条件输出分布对输入的依赖性也必须是可测量的。同样，条件分布必须形成马尔可夫核。选择公理策略恰恰未能满足这一可衡量性要求。

title: p-Adic Dirac Equations, Continuous-Time Quantum Walks, and Quantum Networks
abstract: We introduce a new class of p-adic Dirac equations, formulated in the standard axiomatic framework of quantum mechanics, in which the ordinary spatial derivatives are replaced by non-local operators built from arbitrary integrable kernels. We diagonalize the resulting free Dirac Hamiltonian in momentum space, construct its plane-wave solutions, determine its spectrum, and establish a p-adic charge-conjugation symmetry relating particle and antiparticle sectors. We then discretize the free equation in two ways, both giving genuine continuous-time quantum walks rather than the discrete-time, coined walks that dominate the existing literature: a first construction on a countable covering of the underlying p-adic space, and a second, more explicit construction on a finite, tree-structured graph, for which we prove that the transition probabilities, once the internal (particle/antiparticle) components of the wavefunction are combined, form a genuine, properly normalized set of transition probabilities at every instant of time; in other words, ignoring the internal structure of the walk, it behaves exactly like an ordinary random walk on that graph. Building on this stochastic-matrix property, we discuss how the resulting construction can serve as the foundation of a quantum network with genuinely relativistic-type internal degrees of freedom, complementing earlier, non-relativistic p-adic quantum neural networks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first continuous-time quantum walk whose free dynamics coincides exactly with a Dirac equation on a hierarchical graph. We close with a discussion of the open mathematical and computational problems raised by this construction.
summary:
我们引入了一类新的 p 进狄拉克方程，它是在量子力学的标准公理框架中制定的，其中普通空间导数被由任意可积核构建的非局部算子取代。我们将所得的自由狄拉克哈密顿量在动量空间中对角化，构造其平面波解，确定其频谱，并建立与粒子和反粒子扇区相关的 p 进电荷共轭对称性。然后，我们以两种方式离散自由方程，两种方式都给出真正的连续时间量子游走，而不是在现有文献中占主导地位的离散时间、创造的游走：第一种构造是在底层 p-adic 空间的可数覆盖上，第二种是在有限的树结构图上更明确的构造，对此我们证明，一旦波函数的内部（粒子/反粒子）分量组合起来，转移概率就会在每个瞬间形成真正的、适当归一化的转移概率集。时间；换句话说，忽略游走的内部结构，它的行为与该图上的普通随机游走完全相同。

基于这种随机矩阵特性，我们讨论了由此产生的结构如何作为具有真正相对论型内部自由度的量子网络的基础，以补充早期的非相对论 p 进量子神经网络。据我们所知，这是第一个连续时间量子行走，其自由动力学与层次图上的狄拉克方程完全一致。我们最后讨论了这种结构提出的开放数学和计算问题。

title: Toward Resilient Many-Body Formulations under Incomplete Correlation Models: A Dual-Space Variational Formulation
abstract: Quantum simulations of correlated many-body systems will inevitably operate with imperfect information: the prepared states may arise from incomplete or approximate ansatze, while their measured Hamiltonian and overlap matrix elements are additionally affected by hardware and statistical noise. Robust quantum algorithms will be those that can improve upon reliable lower-level descriptions in spite of these imperfections. We introduce a dual-space nonorthogonal configuration-interaction (DS-NOCI) framework built around this principle. Rather than replacing a classically accessible NOCI reference manifold with correlated quantum states, DS-NOCI retains both spaces and couples them variationally. The reference sector provides a stable many-body backbone, while the quantum states contribute whatever additional correlation directions they contain. With exact matrix elements, the enlarged dual space gives a ground-state energy no higher than either the reference-only NOCI or correlated-only quantum-NOCI spaces, ensuring that an incomplete correlation model cannot degrade the underlying variational description. The additional reference--correlated matrix elements require only one correlated state preparation and are therefore less demanding than the correlated--correlated block already required by quantum variant of NOCI. Molecular benchmarks further show enhanced resilience to imperfect amplitudes and noisy matrix elements. DS-NOCI thus provides a general strategy for building quantum many-body formulations that remain useful when both correlation models and quantum computations are necessarily incomplete and noisy.
summary:
相关多体系统的量子模拟将不可避免地使用不完美的信息进行操作：准备好的状态可能来自不完整或近似的模拟，而它们测量的哈密顿量和重叠矩阵元素还受到硬件和统计噪声的影响。尽管存在这些缺陷，鲁棒的量子算法将能够改进可靠的低级描述。我们引入了围绕这一原理构建的双空间非正交配置交互（DS-NOCI）框架。 DS-NOCI 并没有用相关的量子态替换经典的可访问的 NOCI 参考流形，而是保留了两个空间并以变化的方式耦合它们。参考扇区提供了稳定的多体主干，而量子态贡献了它们包含的任何附加相关方向。通过精确的矩阵元素，扩大的对偶空间给出的基态能量不高于仅参考 NOCI 或仅相关量子 NOCI 空间，确保不完整的相关模型不会降低底层的变分描述。

附加的参考相关矩阵元素仅需要一种相关状态准备，因此比 NOCI 的量子变体已经要求的相关块要求更低。分子基准进一步显示出对不完美振幅和噪声矩阵元素的增强的恢复能力。因此，DS-NOCI 提供了构建量子多体公式的通用策略，当相关模型和量子计算必然不完整且有噪声时，该策略仍然有用。

title: Thermal lifetime of the centralized repetition code: From quantum annealing to social dynamics
abstract: There is an extensive body of research probing the potential of adiabatic quantum computation and quantum annealing to solve hard computational problems. This research endeavor is complicated by noise afflicting hardware during the computational process. An error-correcting approach called quantum annealing correction (QAC) was suggested to mitigate this noise. The QAC approach employs a centralized version of the repetition code in which the qubits are configured in a star-graph pattern with one special qubit playing the role of the hub. In this paper, we explore the thermal physics of the centralized repetition code, using a Lindblad equation framework to analyze its lifetime when coupled to a thermal bath. We show that its centralized configuration leads to thermal stability, enabling the robust storage of a logical bit of information, despite the fact that there is only 1 ferromagnetic Ising interaction per qubit like a 1-dimensional Ising chain.
summary: 有大量研究探索绝热量子计算和量子退火解决困难计算问题的潜力。这项研究工作因计算过程中影响硬件的噪声而变得复杂。建议采用一种称为量子退火校正（QAC）的纠错方法来减轻这种噪声。 QAC 方法采用重复码的集中式版本，其中量子位以星图模式配置，其中一个特殊的量子位充当中枢。在本文中，我们探索了集中式重复码的热物理原理，使用 Lindblad 方程框架来分析其与热浴耦合时的寿命。我们证明，其集中式配置可带来热稳定性，从而能够稳健地存储逻辑信息位，尽管事实上每个量子位只有 1 个铁磁伊辛相互作用，如一维伊辛链。

title: Towards minimal conditions for ergotropy injection in open quantum systems
abstract: Interactions between a quantum system and its environment can inject ergotropy into the system, raising the question of the minimal dimensionality and physical resources required for such injection. We first show that ergotropy injection is impossible under thermal operations when both the system and environment are qubits, whereas it becomes possible when the environment is enlarged to a qutrit. We further show that already in the qubit-qubit setting, relaxing environmental thermality and allowing interactions between system and environment allows ergotropy increment under energy-conserving unitaries. To elucidate the role of interactions, we consider a two-qubit isotropic XY interaction Hamiltonian and identify its distinct degeneracy regimes. We show that, in the central-block regime, when both the initial system and environmental states are incoherent, no ergotropic gain is possible when the environment is initially thermal, irrespective of the interaction strength. In contrast, environmental athermality in the form of population inversion, while retaining incoherence, enables ergotropic injection. We derive the optimal ergotropic gain and show that environmental coherence can enhance it, while system coherence alone need not be beneficial and can even reduce the gain. We further consider the double-degenerate regime, characterized by a finite interaction strength, and demonstrate positive ergotropic gain even for a thermal environment.
summary:
量子系统与其环境之间的相互作用可以将各向异性注入系统，从而提出了这种注入所需的最小维度和物理资源的问题。我们首先证明，当系统和环境都是量子位时，在热操作下，各向异性注入是不可能的，而当环境扩大到量子位时，则各向异性注入就成为可能。我们进一步表明，在量子位-量子位设置中，放松环境热度并允许系统与环境之间的相互作用可以在节能酉法下实现各向异性增量。为了阐明相互作用的作用，我们考虑两个量子位各向同性 XY 相互作用哈密顿量并确定其独特的简并状态。我们表明，在中心块状态下，当初始系统和环境状态都不相干时，当环境最初是热的时，无论相互作用强度如何，都不可能有任何各向异性增益。相比之下，以布居反转形式出现的环境无热性，在保持不相干性的同时，可以实现麦角注射。

我们得出了最佳的各向异性增益，并表明环境相干性可以增强它，而系统相干性本身不一定是有益的，甚至可以减少增益。我们进一步考虑以有限相互作用强度为特征的双简并体系，并证明即使对于热环境也具有正的各向异性增益。

title: Efficient Quantum Error Correction from Three Dimensional Qubit Control
abstract: High-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes can substantially reduce qubit overhead relative to surface codes, but their advantage depends on efficiently realizing nonlocal syndrome extraction. We study the \([[144,12,12]]\) bivariate bicycle code on a neutral-atom architecture with native three-dimensional (3D) geometry, comparing planar and 3D embeddings while holding the code fixed. We characterize spatial efficiency using the logical-qubit density, defined as the number of encoded logical qubits per unit spatial footprint. Because the optical controller's field of view limits the transverse extent of an array, this metric estimates the number of logical qubits that can be accommodated within a fixed optical field of view. The 3D embedding achieves approximately \(4\times\) greater areal logical-qubit density than the planar layout and \(42\times\) greater than a surface-code baseline. It also reduces the bivariate bicycle syndrome-extraction time by roughly \(2\times\) compared to a planar baseline, with fewer movement operations and substantially shorter atom-transport distance. Native 3D geometry can improve both the packing density and executable realization of nonlocal qLDPC codes, making practical performance depend jointly on code structure, optical geometry, transport scheduling, and hardware-level noise. This motivates further development of control techniques in 3D.
summary:
高速量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码相对于表面码可以大大减少量子位开销，但其优势取决于有效实现非局部校正子提取。我们研究了具有原生三维 (3D) 几何结构的中性原子架构上的 \([[144,12,12]]\) 双变量自行车代码，在保持代码固定的情况下比较平面和 3D 嵌入。我们使用逻辑量子位密度来表征空间效率，逻辑量子位密度定义为每单位空间占用的编码逻辑量子位的数量。由于光学控制器的视场限制了阵列的横向范围，因此该指标估计固定光学视场内可容纳的逻辑量子位的数量。 3D 嵌入实现的面积逻辑量子位密度大约比平面布局大 4 倍，比表面代码基线大 42 倍。与平面基线相比，它还减少了双变量自行车综合症提取时间大约“2”倍，移动操作更少，原子传输距离也大大缩短。

原生 3D 几何可以提高非局部 qLDPC 代码的封装密度和可执行实现，从而使实际性能共同取决于代码结构、光学几何、传输调度和硬件级噪声。这推动了 3D 控制技术的进一步发展。

title: Gradient-based optimal control of the non-Hermitian skin effect in optomechanical arrays
abstract:
In single-port non-Hermitian sensors the Petermann factor offsets susceptibility gains, imposing a strict resource bound on metrological precision. We test whether a multi-port geometry can evade this bound: a double-chain optomechanical ladder with opposing non-reciprocal hoppings spatially separates signal amplification from quantum-noise drainage, and gradient-based differentiable optimal control (DOC) maximizes the resource-normalized Fisher information $\Fnorm$ subject to a Hurwitz-stability constraint. Across system sizes $N\in\{
um{6},\dots,
um{16}\}$ the optimizer returns $\Fnorm>0$ in every case, with two coexisting solution classes whose selection is initialization-dependent: deep-stability configurations achieve $\Fnorm\in
umrange{0.937}{0.987}$ with attenuated transmission, while marginal-stability configurations deliver directional gain $\Gfwd\in\qtyrange{13.5}{15.5}{\dB}$ with isolation $\Iso\in\qtyrange{40}{64}{\dB}$. A multi-restart ensemble reveals these classes are the endpoints of a precision--gain frontier. All solutions remain Hurwitz-stable under \qty{5}{\percent} disorder (\qty{87.5}{\percent} recovery), and the deep-stability advantage survives realistic preamplifier noise at $\Fnormeff\approx
um{0.3}$--$
um{0.5}$. Mapped onto circuit-QED parameters, the architecture enables sub-attonewton force sensing and broadband axion searches across the \qtyrange{1}{10}{\giga\hertz} band.
summary:
在单端口非厄米传感器中，彼得曼因子抵消了磁化率增益，对计量精度施加了严格的资源限制。我们测试多端口几何结构是否可以逃避这个界限：具有相反非互易跳频的双链光机械梯在空间上将信号放大与量子噪声排放分开，并且基于梯度的可微最优控制（DOC）最大化资源归一化费舍尔信息$ \ Fnorm $受Hurwitz稳定性约束。在系统规模 $N\in\{
um{6},\dots,
um{16}\}$ 中，优化器在每种情况下都会返回 $\Fnorm>0$，其中有两个共存的解决方案类，其选择取决于初始化：深度稳定性配置通过衰减传输实现 $\Fnorm\in
umrange{0.937}{0.987}$，而边际稳定性配置提供方向增益$\Gfwd\in\qtyrange{13.5}{15.5}{\dB}$ 隔离 $\Iso\in\qtyrange{40}{64}{\dB}$。多次重启的集成揭示了这些类是精度增益边界的端点。

所有解决方案在 \qty{5}{\percent} 无序下保持 Hurwitz 稳定（\qty{87.5}{\percent} 恢复），并且深度稳定性优势可以在 $\Fnormeff\approx
um{0.3}$--$
um{0.5}$ 下克服现实前置放大器噪声。映射到电路 QED 参数上，该架构可实现跨 \qtyrange{1}{10}{\giga\hertz} 频带的亚阿托牛顿力传感和宽带轴子搜索。

title: One-Shot and Concurrent Hitting Times for Grover-Coined Quantum Walks on Cubelike Graphs
abstract: We study the one-shot and concurrent hitting for the discrete-time Grover-coined quantum walk on cubelike graphs $G=\text{Cay}(\mathbb Z_2^d,\Omega)$ of degree $\Delta=|\Omega|$. Starting from the vertex labeled $0$, we identify $\sigma=\bigoplus_{\omega\in\Omega}\omega$ as a natural target vertex; for the hypercube, $\sigma$ is precisely the antipodal vertex. For families with $\Delta\to\infty$, let $T$ be an integer having the same parity as $\Delta$ and satisfying $ \left|T-\frac{\pi\Delta}{2}\right|\leq 1. $ We show that the probability $p_T(\sigma)$ of finding the walker at $\sigma$ when it is measured at time $T$ satisfies $$ p_T(\sigma)=1-O(\Delta^{-1/5}). $$ Thus the target is found with probability tending to one after $\Theta(\Delta)$ steps. For the concurrently measured walk, let $H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma)$ denote the probability that the target is detected at or before time $T$ when it is tested after every step. We prove $$ p_T(\sigma)\leq T H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma), $$ which implies $H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma)=\Omega(\Delta^{-1})$ over the same time scale. The proof uses the Walsh-Fourier decomposition, an exact two-dimensional reduction of each Fourier mode, and a universal second-moment identity for the associated character sums. Our results extend Kempe's hypercube hitting phenomenon (J. Kempe, Probab. Theory Relat. Fields 133, 215-235, 2005) to arbitrary cubelike generating sets and establish the conjectured asymptotic hitting behavior for cublelike and augmented cubes in Mulherkar, Rajdeepak and Sunitha (Int. J. Quantum Inf. 20,2250020, 2022)
summary:
我们研究了立方体图 $G=\text{Cay}(\mathbb Z_2^d,\Omega)$ 度 $\Delta=|\Omega|$ 上离散时间 Grover 创造的量子行走的一次性和并发命中。从标记为$0$的顶点开始，我们将$\sigma=\bigoplus_{\omega\in\Omega}\omega$识别为自然目标顶点；对于超立方体，$\sigma$ 正是对映顶点。对于 $\Delta\to\infty$ 的族，令 $T$ 为与 $\Delta$ 具有相同奇偶性并满足 $ \left|T-\frac{\pi\Delta}{2}\right|\leq 1 的整数。 $ 我们证明，当在 $T$ 时间测量时，在 $\sigma$ 处找到步行者的概率 $p_T(\sigma)$ 满足 $$ p_T(\sigma)=1-O(\Delta^{-1/5})。 $$ 因此，在 $\Theta(\Delta)$ 步骤之后，目标的概率趋于 1。对于同时测量的步行，令 $H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma)$ 表示在每个步骤后进行测试时在时间 $T$ 或之前检测到目标的概率。我们证明 $$ p_T(\sigma)\leq T H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma), $$ 这意味着在相同的时间尺度上 $H_T^{\mathrm{Conc}}(\sigma)=\Omega(\Delta^{-1})$。

该证明使用沃尔什-傅里叶分解、每个傅里叶模式的精确二维简化以及相关字符和的通用二阶矩恒等式。我们的结果将 Kempe 的超立方体碰撞现象（J. Kempe, Probab. Theory Relat. Fields 133, 215-235, 2005）扩展到任意立方体生成集，并在 Mulherkar、Rajdeepak 和 Sunitha 中建立了立方体和增强立方体的推测渐近碰撞行为（Int. J. Quantum Inf. 20,2250020， 2022）

title: State-Based Quantum Operations: Chameleon Gates
abstract: We introduce chameleon gates as a natural generalization of conventional quantum controlled-gates. Chameleon gates are state-based quantum controlled-operations that retain standard elements such as control and target systems, while introducing a new feature: the quantum knob. This knob is a quantum signal (state) that determines the operation performed by the gate. Consequently, the action and form of a chameleon gate depend dynamically on the quantum knob, allowing the gate to adapt its operation and implement transformations that are not necessarily unitary. This shapeshifting property is in stark contrast to conventional quantum controlled-gates, whose actions are fixed and cannot be modified. We also propose how chameleon gates can be realized using conventional quantum gates available in current quantum technologies. We then employ chameleon gates as a useful building block within the recently proposed state-based quantum computation (SBQC) framework. Using this approach, we demonstrate the simulation of state-dependent (nonlinear) quantum evolutions.
summary: 我们引入变色龙门作为传统量子控制门的自然推广。变色龙门是基于状态的量子控制操作，保留了控制和目标系统等标准元素，同时引入了新功能：量子旋钮。该旋钮是一个量子信号（状态），决定门执行的操作。因此，变色龙门的动作和形式动态地取决于量子旋钮，允许门适应其操作并实现不一定是单一的变换。这种变形特性与传统的量子控制门形成鲜明对比，传统的量子控制门的动作是固定的且无法修改。我们还提出了如何使用当前量子技术中可用的传统量子门来实现变色龙门。然后，我们在最近提出的基于状态的量子计算（SBQC）框架中采用变色龙门作为有用的构建块。使用这种方法，我们演示了状态相关（非线性）量子演化的模拟。

title: DPRQ: A Dynamic Programming-based Qubit Routing Algorithm for Collective Communication in Distributed Quantum Computing
abstract: Distributed quantum computing (DQC) offers a promising approach to scale quantum computing by overcoming the resource limitations of a single quantum processor. However, inter-node communication remains a major bottleneck of DQC due to inefficient and error-prone entanglement distribution. Optimizing inter-node communication can not only reduce the amount of entanglement resource needed to execute a quantum circuit but also improve execution speed and accuracy of the results. This paper proposes DPRQ, a qubit routing algorithm for minimizing inter-node communication in distributed quantum circuits divided into collective communication blocks. Unlike current approaches that utilize greedy block-level qubit routing strategies, DPRQ employs a dynamic programming-based technique focused on global circuit-level optimization, while capturing inter-block dependencies. We evaluated DPRQ on four sets of quantum circuits and a variety of DQC configurations. The results demonstrate that DPRQ's innovative routing strategy achieves an average of 24.40% reduction with a maximum of 85.06% reduction in inter-node communication, when compared to the state-of-the-art collective communication-based DQC compiler QuComm.
summary:
分布式量子计算（DQC）通过克服单个量子处理器的资源限制，提供了一种有前途的扩展量子计算的方法。然而，由于低效且容易出错的纠缠分布，节点间通信仍然是 DQC 的主要瓶颈。优化节点间通信不仅可以减少执行量子电路所需的纠缠资源量，还可以提高执行速度和结果的准确性。本文提出了 DPRQ，一种量子位路由算法，用于最小化划分为集体通信块的分布式量子电路中的节点间通信。与当前利用贪婪块级量子位路由策略的方法不同，DPRQ 采用基于动态编程的技术，专注于全局电路级优化，同时捕获块间依赖性。我们在四组量子电路和各种 DQC 配置上评估了 DPRQ。

结果表明，与最先进的基于集体通信的 DQC 编译器 QuComm 相比，DPRQ 的创新路由策略平均减少了 24.40%，节点间通信最多减少了 85.06%。

title: Qmes: Quantum Meta-Learning for Encoding Selection in Quantum Kernel Methods
abstract: Selecting an effective encoding quantum circuit is a key challenge in quantum kernel methods because different feature maps can lead to different performance. Conventional methods require constructing and evaluating every circuit for each new dataset, making it computationally expensive. We present Qmes, an open-source Python package that automatically recommends circuits through meta-learning. Qmes characterizes a dataset using classical complexity measures and queries a pre-trained model to recommend circuits without quantum evaluation at inference time. The package provides modular components for meta-feature extraction, quantum-kernel evaluation, recommender training, model selection, and user-defined circuit extension. We validate Qmes on 105 classification and 86 regression benchmark datasets. Qmes reduces the mean recommendation regret by 2.2x and 4.2x for classification and regression, respectively, compared to a non-adaptive baseline, with statistical significance confirmed via a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test ($p < 10^{-4}$). Qmes thus enables efficient and practical encoding-circuit selection for quantum kernel methods.
summary: 选择有效的编码量子电路是量子核方法中的一个关键挑战，因为不同的特征图会导致不同的性能。传统方法需要为每个新数据集构建和评估每个电路，这使得计算成本昂贵。我们推出了 Qmes，一个开源 Python 包，可以通过元学习自动推荐电路。 Qmes 使用经典复杂性度量来表征数据集，并查询预先训练的模型来推荐电路，而无需在推理时进行量子评估。该软件包提供了用于元特征提取、量子内核评估、推荐训练、模型选择和用户定义电路扩展的模块化组件。我们在 105 个分类和 86 个回归基准数据集上验证了 Qmes。与非自适应基线相比，Qmes 分别将分类和回归的平均推荐遗憾减少了 2.2 倍和 4.2 倍，并通过配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验确认了统计显着性 ($p < 10^{-4}$)。因此，Qmes 能够为量子核方法提供高效且实用的编码电路选择。

title: Lindblad Multiproduct Formulas
abstract: We introduce Lindblad Multiproduct Formulas: a quantum error mitigation technique that uses two-dimensional tensor networks contracted with loop-corrected belief propagation. The quantities required to implement the error mitigation scheme that are evaluated with tensor networks can be less computationally expensive to calculate than the expectation values themselves, thus allowing for the possibility of applying our method to certain systems for which tensor network methods may struggle to calculate the observable quantities of interest. The workflow incorporates Clifford rescaling techniques and outputs an estimated error bar. We apply our method to a model of two-dimensional discrete time crystals studied previously and implement it on $65$ qubits arranged in a $3\!\times\!3$ heavy-hexagonal topology on the quantum computer ibm_basquecountry. We show that a GPU implementation of the classical part of our workflow achieves a speedup of up to $5.6\times$.
summary: 我们引入 Lindblad 多积公式：一种量子误差缓解技术，该技术使用与循环校正信念传播契约的二维张量网络。实现用张量网络评估的误差缓解方案所需的量可以比期望值本身的计算成本更低，因此可以将我们的方法应用于某些系统，对于这些系统，张量网络方法可能难以计算感兴趣的可观察量。该工作流程结合了 Clifford 重新缩放技术并输出估计的误差条。我们将我们的方法应用于之前研究的二维离散时间晶体模型，并在量子计算机 ibm_basquecountry 上以 $3\!\times\!3$ 重六边形拓扑排列的 $65$ 量子位上实现。我们展示了工作流程经典部分的 GPU 实现实现了高达 5.6 美元\times 的加速。

title: Hadamard Rigidity of Positive Sojourn Time Distributions for Rotation Coins
abstract: We study the distribution of the positive sojourn time for a one-dimensional two state quantum walk, conditioned on return to the origin. Konno showed that, for the Hadamard walk, this conditional distribution is exactly uniform at times divisible by $4$. In this paper, we investigate whether this finite time exact uniformity characterizes the Hadamard coin within the family of rotation coins. For a fixed initial state, we prove that the following three conditions are equivalent for rotation coins: the conditional distribution is exactly uniform at time $8$; the conditional distribution is exactly uniform at every time $4m$ with $m\ge2$; and the coin is the Hadamard coin. Thus, the uniformity phenomenon found by Konno is characterized as a rigidity phenomenon of the Hadamard coin within the rotation coin family. The proof uses a matrix-valued generating function for paths returning to the origin. We analyze the algebraic structure arising from an absorbing process on the half line. Finally, by comparing low degree coefficients at time $8$, we show that exact uniformity forces the rotation coin to be the Hadamard coin.
summary: 我们研究以返回原点为条件的一维二态量子行走的正停留时间的分布。 Konno 证明，对于 Hadamard 步行，这种条件分布有时完全均匀，可被 $4$ 整除。在本文中，我们研究了这种有限时间精确均匀性是否是旋转硬币家族中哈达玛硬币的特征。对于固定的初始状态，我们证明以下三个条件对于旋转硬币是等效的：条件分布在$8$时刻完全均匀；条件分布在每次 $4m$ 和 $m\ge2$ 时都是完全均匀的；硬币是哈达玛硬币。因此，绀野发现的均匀性现象被表征为旋转硬币家族中哈达玛硬币的刚性现象。该证明使用矩阵值生成函数来表示返回原点的路径。我们分析半线上吸收过程产生的代数结构。最后，通过比较时间 $8$ 的低阶系数，我们表明精确的均匀性迫使旋转硬币成为哈达玛硬币。

title: Optimal inequalities for completely bounded polynomials and the limitations of quantum query algorithms
abstract: We consider the problem of establishing limitations on the power of quantum query algorithms via the completely bounded polynomial method. In particular, we prove several optimal functional inequalities involving different notions of completely bounded polynomials. These inequalities lead to limiting theorems for the power of quantum query algorithms that improve on prior works. 1. An optimal root-influence bound for block-multilinear polynomials. Prior work showed that block-multilinear polynomials $p$ of degree $t$ satisfy a root-influence bound, $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\geq \sum_i \sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}/t^2$, which is stronger than the bound appearing in the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. We find the optimal constant in that inequality: $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\geq \sum_i \sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}/t$. Since the amplitudes of quantum algorithms that query disjoint blocks of inputs-such as $t$-fold forrelation- are block-multilinear polynomials with $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\leq 1,$ our inequality shows that they satisfy $t\geq \sum_i\sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}$. We prove that this inequality yields both a more efficient classical simulation than prior results based on the Aaronson-Ambainis argument, and a qualitative improvement: all classical queries are nonadaptive. 2. Optimal Fourier growth of the highest level of quantum query algorithms. We show that for every polynomial $p$ defined on $\{-1,1\}^n$ of degree $2t$, the Fourier Growth at the level $2t,$ namely $\|\widehat p_{2t}\|_{\ell_1}$, satisfies $\|\widehat p_{2t}\|_{\ell_1}\leq (en/(2t-1))^{\frac{2t-1}{2}}\|p\|_{\text{cb}}$. This is optimal up to the factor $e$, as witnessed by $2t$-fold forrelation. As quantum query algorithms that make $t$ queries (to the whole input) satisfy $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\leq 1$, this yields a Fourier growth bound for these algorithms, partially resolving a question by Girish (STOC, 2026).
summary:
我们考虑通过完全有界多项式方法对量子查询算法的能力建立限制的问题。特别是，我们证明了涉及完全有界多项式的不同概念的几种最优函数不等式。这些不等式导致了量子查询算法能力的限制定理，这些定理改进了先前的工作。 1. 块多线性多项式的最优根影响界。先前的工作表明，$t$ 次的块多线性多项式 $p$ 满足根影响界限 $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\geq \sum_i \sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}/t^2$，该界限比 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想中出现的界限更强。我们找到该不等式中的最佳常数：$\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\geq \sum_i \sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}/t$。由于查询不相交输入块的量子算法的振幅（例如 $t$ 折叠关系）是块多线性多项式，且 $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\leq 1，$ 我们的不等式表明它们满足 $t\geq \sum_i\sqrt{\mathrm{Inf}_i[p]}$。

我们证明，这种不等式不仅产生了比基于 Aaronson-Ambainis 论证的先前结果更有效的经典模拟，而且产生了质的改进：所有经典查询都是非自适应的。 2.最高级别量子查询算法的最优傅里叶增长。我们证明，对于 $\{-1,1\}^n$ 上 $\{-1,1\}^n$ 的 $2t$ 阶多项式定义的每个多项式 $p$，$2t,$ 级别的傅立叶增长即 $\|\widehat p_{2t}\|_{\ell_1}$ 满足 $\|\widehat p_{2t}\|_{\ell_1}\leq (zh/(2t-1))^{\frac{2t-1}{2}}\|p\|_{\text{cb}}$.正如 $2t$ 倍关系所证明的那样，这在因子 $e$ 范围内是最佳的。作为使 $t$ 查询（对整个输入）满足 $\|p\|_{\text{cb}}\leq 1$ 的量子查询算法，这会产生这些算法的傅里叶增长界限，部分解决了 Girish 的问题（STOC，2026）。

title: A double-resonator coupler for high-fidelity two-qubit gates between superconducting qubits
abstract: Tunable couplers have enabled two-qubit gate fidelities in superconducting quantum processors to approach $99.9\%$, yet simultaneously suppressing residual interactions and maintaining flexible qubit-frequency allocation remain central challenges for scaling. Here, we propose a double-resonator coupler (DRC) consisting of two resonators interconnected by a single Josephson junction and a capacitor. The hybridized resonator modes provide two mediated exchange paths whose interference controls the qubit-qubit interaction. The DRC enables complete cancellation of residual $ZZ$ interaction for qubit-qubit detunings well outside the straddling regime, even in the absence of direct qubit-qubit coupling, thereby relaxing constraints on frequency allocation and qubit placement. Away from the idle point, the same circuit provides a strong $ZZ$ interaction of approximately $70\,\mathrm{MHz}$, enabling a $20\,\mathrm{ns}$ controlled-Z gate with simulated coherent infidelity below $10^{-5}$. These results establish the DRC as a flexible single-junction coupler architecture for high-fidelity superconducting quantum processors.
summary: 可调谐耦合器使超导量子处理器中的两个量子位门保真度接近 99.9%$，但同时抑制残余相互作用和保持灵活的量子位频率分配仍然是扩展的核心挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种双谐振器耦合器（DRC），由通过单个约瑟夫森结和电容器互连的两个谐振器组成。混合谐振器模式提供两条中介交换路径，其干扰控制量子位-量子位相互作用。即使在没有直接的量子位-量子位耦合的情况下，DRC 也能够完全消除跨界之外的量子位-量子位失谐的剩余 $ZZ$ 相互作用，从而放松对频率分配和量子位放置的限制。远离空闲点，同一电路提供大约 $70\,\mathrm{MHz}$ 的强 $ZZ$ 交互，从而实现 $20\,\mathrm{ns}$ 受控 Z 门，模拟相干不保真度低于 $10^{-5}$。这些结果使 DRC 成为一种用于高保真超导量子处理器的灵活单结耦合器架构。

title: The marginal is pretty good
abstract: One-shot information theory measures often require an optimization over states, but the form of these optimizers can be complicated or depend on the initial problem in nonlinear ways. In this note, we show that in many instances using the marginal instead of the optimal state is sufficiently good and only changes the result by a small factor. We prove that for the Petz-Rényi divergence of order $\alpha\in[1/2,1)$, replacing the optimizing state on $B$ by the marginal $\rho_B$ results in a multiplicative overhead of at most $1/\alpha$. We also show a similar relation for the fidelity, and in the case of pure or quantum-classical states for the sandwiched Rényi divergence.
summary: 一次性信息论测量通常需要对状态进行优化，但这些优化器的形式可能很复杂或以非线性方式依赖于初始问题。在这篇文章中，我们表明，在许多情况下，使用边际状态而不是最优状态已经足够好，并且只会使结果发生很小的变化。我们证明，对于 $\alpha\in[1/2,1)$ 阶的 Petz-Rényi 散度，用边际 $\rho_B$ 替换 $B$ 上的优化状态会导致最多 $1/\alpha$ 的乘法开销。我们还展示了保真度的类似关系，以及在纯态或量子经典态的情况下夹层 Rényi 散度的关系。

title: Quantum Optimisation for Protein-Protein Interaction Network Alignment
abstract: Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network alignment combines topological and sequence information to identify conserved modules across species, but global alignment remains challenging: heuristics sacrifice optimality, while exact methods lack scalability. We model the alignment as a weighted maximum common induced subgraph problem and reformulate it through the modular product graph to a minimum-weight vertex cover on the complement, with node weights carrying sequence similarity. To solve this problem, we develop a hybrid framework combining kernelisation, branch-and-bound, and seven Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA) formulations. These formulations differ in how the cover constraints are enforced, from penalty terms in the cost Hamiltonian to mixers confined to the feasible subspace. For single round QAOA, we derive closed-form expressions for the expected cost of four circulant mixer variants, enabling performance characterisation without circuit simulation. Applied to synthetic and real-world networks reduced to KEGG pathways, the QAOA formulations achieve high topological conservation on the aligned core while at least maintaining biological conservation comparable to leading classical aligners, at the cost of reduced node coverage. Across selected KEGG pathways, the aligned subnetworks retain disease-associated proteins, preserving biologically relevant information. Cheaper formulations leave more edges uncovered, while enforcing feasibility in the mixer raises circuit depth by one to two orders of magnitude. Together, these results highlight the potential of quantum optimisation for PPI network alignment and the resource trade-offs that will shape its scalability as quantum hardware matures.
summary:
蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络比对结合了拓扑和序列信息来识别跨物种的保守模块，但全局比对仍然具有挑战性：启发式牺牲了最优性，而精确方法缺乏可扩展性。我们将对齐建模为加权最大公共诱导子图问题，并通过模块化乘积图将其重新表述为补集上的最小权重顶点覆盖，其中节点权重带有序列相似性。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一个混合框架，结合了核化、分支定界和七种量子近似优化算法（QAOA）公式。这些公式的不同之处在于如何强制执行覆盖约束，从成本哈密顿量中的惩罚项到仅限于可行子空间的混合器。对于单轮 QAOA，我们推导出四种循环混频器变体的预期成本的封闭式表达式，无需电路仿真即可实现性能表征。

应用于简化为 KEGG 路径的合成网络和现实网络时，QAOA 公式在对齐核心上实现了高度拓扑守恒，同时至少保持了与领先的经典对齐器相当的生物守恒，但代价是节点覆盖范围减少。在选定的 KEGG 通路中，对齐的子网络保留了与疾病相关的蛋白质，从而保留了生物学相关信息。更便宜的配方会留下更多的边缘未被覆盖，同时在混合器中增强可行性将电路深度提高一到两个数量级。总之，这些结果凸显了 PPI 网络对齐的量子优化的潜力以及随着量子硬件的成熟而影响其可扩展性的资源权衡。

title: Memory-Optimal Sequential Synthesis of Multimode Gaussian Transformations
abstract: In modular quantum computing architectures, communication between hardware modules is mediated by traveling qumodes sent through transmission lines. Each output qumode interacts with the emitting module only once through a beam-splitter-type interaction and becomes inaccessible to that module after emission. Information required for subsequent outputs must therefore remain in long-lived memory qumodes. For a prescribed multimode Gaussian transformation on $N$ qumodes, this work determines the minimum memory cost for any given emission order, constructs an explicit sequential protocol attaining this minimum, and develops a greedy method for identifying memory-efficient emission orders. The transformation is represented by a symplectic matrix $S$, specified either directly or through a Gaussian gate sequence. The exact minimum memory cost is obtained from the ranks of submatrices of $S$ and further reduces to a support-based counting rule whose computational cost is linear in the size of the support data. When $S$ is specified directly, a matrix-based protocol attains the minimum memory cost. If instead $S$ is specified through a gate sequence, the original gates can be reused without additional synthesis, although the resulting memory usage need not be minimal. Gaussian transformations with local support on a $D$-dimensional cubic lattice can be realized sequentially with $O(N^{(D-1)/D})$ memory qumodes. The protocols also apply to non-Gaussian inputs, including GKP and cat states, and thereby provide an explicit, resource-efficient scheme for intermodule communication in modular architectures for universal continuous-variable quantum computation.
summary:
在模块化量子计算架构中，硬件模块之间的通信是通过传输线发送的移动量子模式来调节的。每个输出 qumode 仅通过分束器类型的交互与发射模块交互一次，并且在发射后该模块将无法访问。因此，后续输出所需的信息必须保留在长期内存 qumode 中。对于 $N$ qumode 上规定的多模高斯变换，这项工作确定了任何给定发射顺序的最小内存成本，构建了达到该最小值的显式顺序协议，并开发了一种用于识别内存高效发射顺序的贪婪方法。该变换由辛矩阵 $S$ 表示，直接指定或通过高斯门序列指定。确切的最小内存成本是从 $S$ 的子矩阵的行列中获得的，并进一步简化为基于支持的计数规则，其计算成本与支持数据的大小呈线性关系。当直接指定 $S$ 时，基于矩阵的协议可以获得最小的内存成本。

如果通过门序列指定 $S$，则可以重用原始门而无需额外综合，尽管最终的内存使用量不必是最小的。在 $D$ 维立方晶格上具有局部支持的高斯变换可以使用 $O(N^{(D-1)/D})$ 内存 qumode 顺序实现。该协议还适用于非高斯输入，包括 GKP 和 cat 状态，从而为通用连续变量量子计算的模块化架构中的模块间通信提供了明确的、资源高效的方案。

title: Compiling the 2D Fermi-Hubbard ground-state energy estimation algorithm for active volume quantum architectures
abstract: As quantum computing enters the early fault-tolerant era, circuit compilation choices will increasingly depend on details of the underlying architecture rather than solely optimizing for generic proxies such as non-Clifford count. We present an active-volume-aware compilation of the ground-state energy estimation algorithm for the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model using quantum phase estimation and Trotterized time evolution. The proposed compilation reduces the active volume across $L\times L$ square lattices with $L=4$ to $20$, achieving up to a $3.9\times$ reduction over prior work optimized for non-Clifford cost. As a by-product of these compilation improvements, the resulting circuits also achieve state-of-the-art Toffoli counts, with a ~$2\times$ reduction for the $L=20$ case. Lastly, the active volume architecture and recent execution scheduling advances provide a means of translating these reduction trends into runtime. This demonstrates the increasing importance of architecture-aware compilation for practical early fault-tolerant quantum computing.
summary: 随着量子计算进入早期容错时代，电路编译选择将越来越依赖于底层架构的细节，而不是仅仅针对非 Clifford 计数等通用代理进行优化。我们使用量子相位估计和 Trotterized 时间演化，提出了二维费米-哈伯德模型基态能量估计算法的主动体积感知编译。所提出的编译将 $L=4$ 的 $L\times L$ 方格的活动体积减少到 $20$，与之前针对非 Clifford 成本优化的工作相比，减少了 $3.9\times$。作为这些编译改进的副产品，所得电路还实现了最先进的 Toffoli 计数，在 $L=20$ 的情况下减少了约 $2\times$。最后，活动卷架构和最近的执行调度进步提供了一种将这些减少趋势转化为运行时间的方法。这表明架构感知编译对于实用的早期容错量子计算越来越重要。

title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
abstract: Advanced optical quantum technologies demands high quality quantum light generation at very high rates. Here, we report on a deterministic single-photon source that simultaneously combines high excitation rates with high system efficiency to reach over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux. The source delivers optical power of over 100 pW, as is measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter, enabling a simple and direct way of determining the single-photon source fiber efficiency.
summary: 先进的光学量子技术需要以非常高的速率产生高质量的量子光。在这里，我们报告了一种确定性单光子源，它同时结合了高激发速率和高系统效率，可达到超过 500 MHz 的光纤内单光子通量。该光源提供超过 100 pW 的光功率（使用现成的功率计测量），从而能够以简单直接的方式确定单光子源光纤效率。

title: Towards Scaling Quantum Fine-Tuning of Foundational Time Series Models for Classification
abstract: Time-series foundation models produce rich embeddings, but whether quantum models can exploit them, and how far hybrid classical-quantum architectures scale, remains unclear. We address this by fine-tuning Chronos for power-grid event classification (PSML-5) with a quantum head on the model's embeddings. Grouping embeddings by physical sensor type before summarization already surpasses the best published baseline built for this benchmark, and with finer-grained features the quantum head outperforms a larger classical multilayer perceptron on identical inputs by 1.7-2.0 percentage points of balanced accuracy. Yet the gains saturate: past a point, feeding more information to the same fixed-width register yields no improvement. We show the bottleneck is neither the supply of information nor circuit expressiveness, but the bandwidth of the data intake. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the wing module, a self-contained few-qubit circuit that feeds additional information into the core circuit through a sparse, one-way coupling. Under a preregistered four-seed protocol, we attach wings to a fixed 12-qubit core with fixed features. Balanced accuracy increases with each added wing, from 83.6% with no wings (13 qubits, including a post-selection qubit) to 85.2% with two (19 qubits). Ablations establish that a circuit enlarged without new information gains nothing, while a wing fed information from the wrong sample harms accuracy. These results reframe scaling for quantum fine-tuning: added qubits help when they carry added inputs, not merely more parameters. Wings offer a modular and stable route to widening that bandwidth.
summary:
时间序列基础模型产生丰富的嵌入，但量子模型是否可以利用它们，以及混合经典量子架构的扩展程度仍不清楚。我们通过在模型嵌入上使用量子头来微调 Chronos 电网事件分类 (PSML-5) 来解决这个问题。在汇总之前按物理传感器类型对嵌入进行分组已经超过了为此基准构建的最佳已发布基线，并且凭借更细粒度的功能，量子头在相同输入上的平衡精度比更大的经典多层感知器高出 1.7-2.0 个百分点。然而，增益已经饱和：超过某一点，向同一个固定宽度寄存器提供更多信息不会产生任何改进。我们表明瓶颈既不是信息的提供，也不是电路的表达能力，而是数据摄入的带宽。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了 wing 模块，这是一种独立的少量子位电路，通过稀疏的单向耦合将附加信息馈送到核心电路中。根据预先注册的四种子协议，我们将翅膀附加到具有固定功能的固定 12 量子位核心上。

每添加一个翼，平衡精度就会提高，从无翼（13 个量子位，包括后选择量子位）的 83.6% 提高到有两个翼（19 个量子位）的 85.2%。消融表明，在没有新信息的情况下扩大的电路不会获得任何收益，而从错误样本中获取信息的机翼会损害准确性。这些结果重新构建了量子微调的扩展：增加的量子位在携带更多输入而不仅仅是更多参数时会有所帮助。 Wings 提供了一种模块化且稳定的途径来扩大带宽。
